Mishneh Torah, Shofar, Sukkah and Lulav: Kamma tekiot chayyav adam lishmoa berosh hashshana. tesha tekiot. lefi shenneemar terua beyovel uverosh hashshana shalosh peamim. vechol terua peshuta lefaneha ufeshuta leachareha. umippi hashshemua lamdu shekkol teruot shel chodesh hashshevii echad hen. ben berosh hashshana ben beyom hakkippurim shel yovel tesha tekiot tokin bechol echad mishshenehen. tekia uterua utekia. tekia uterua utekia. tekia uterua utekia:

Terua zo haamura battora nistappek lanu bah safek lefi orech hashshanim verov haggalut veen anu yodin heach hi. im hi hayelala shemmeyallelin hannashim benehen beet shemmeyabbevin. o haanacha kederech sheyyeanach haadam paam achar paam kesheyyidag libbo middavar gadol. o shenehem keechad haanacha vehayelala sheddarkah lavo achareha hen hannikrain terua. shekkach derech haddoeg mitanneach techilla veachar kach meyallel. lechach anu osin hakkol:

Hayelala hi sheanu korin terua. vehaanacha zo achar zo hi sheanu korin otah shelosha shevarim. nimtza seder hattekiot kach hu. mevarech vetokea tekia veachareha shelosha shevarim veachareha terua veachareha tekia. vechozer keseder ze shalosh peamim. vetokea tekia veachareha shelosha shevarim veachareha tekia vechozer kasseder hazze shalosh peamim. vetokea tekia veachareha terua veachareha tekia vechozer keseder ze shalosh peamim. nimtza minyan hattekiot sheloshim kede lehistallek min hassafek:

Shiur terua kishte tekiot. shiur shelosha shevarim kitrua. hare shettaka veheria vetaka tekia arukka umashach bah kishtayim barishona. en omrin techashev kishte tekiot veyaria achareha veyachazor veyitka. ella afillu mashach bah kol hayyom enah ella tekia achat vechozer vetokea umeria vetokea shalosh peamim:

Shama tekia achat beshaa achat usheniyya beshaa sheniyya afillu shaha kol hayyom kullo hare ellu mitztarfin veyatza yede chovato. vehu sheyyishma kol bava mehen al sidra. lo sheyyishma terua veachareha shete tekiot o shete tekiot veacharehen terua vechayyotze baze:

Shama tesha tekiot mittisha bene adam keechad lo yatza afillu yede achat. tekia mizze uterua mizze utekia mishshelishi baze achar ze yatza vaafillu beserugin vaafillu kol hayyom kullo. veeno yotze yede chovato ad sheyyishma kol hattesha tekiot shekkullan mitzva achat hen lefichach meakkevot zo et zo:

Hatztzibbur chayyavin lishmoa hattekiot al seder habberachot. ketzad. omer sheliach tzibbur avot ugevurot ukedushshat hashshem umalchuyyot vetokea shalosh. veomer zichronot vetokea shalosh. veomer shofarot vetokea shalosh. veomer avoda vehodaya uvirkat kohanim:

Shalosh berachot emtzaiyyot ellu shel rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim shel yovel shehen malchuyyot vezichronot veshofarot meakkevot zo et zo. vetzarich lomar bechol beracha mehen asara pesukim meen habberacha. shelosha pesukim min hattora. ushelosha missefer tehillim. ushelosha min hanneviim. veechad min hattora mashlim bo. veim hishlim benavi yatza. veim amar pasuk echad min hattora veechad min hakketuvim veechad min hanneviim yatza. vaafillu amar uvetoratcha Adonai elohenu katuv lemor veamar pasuk shel tora vehifsik shuv eno tzarich kelum:

En mazkirin zichronot malchuyyot veshofarot shel puranut. zichronot kegon <small>(Tehillim 78 39)</small> "vayyizkor ki vasar hemma" vechulei. malchuyyot kegon <small>(Yechezkel 20 33)</small> "bechema shefucha emloch alechem". shofarot kegon <small>(Hoshea 5 8)</small> "tiku shofar baggiva" vechulei. velo zichron yachid afillu letova kegon <small>(Tehillim 106 4)</small> "zachreni Adonai birtzon ammecha". <small>(Nechemya 5 19)</small> <small>(Nechemya 13 lo)</small> "zachra li elohay letova". ufikdonot enan kezichronot. kegon <small>(Shemot 3 16)</small> "pakod pakadti etchem". veyesh lo lehazekir puranut shel ummot akkum kegon <small>(Tehillim 99 1)</small> "Adonai malach yirgezu ammim". <small>(Tehillim 137 7)</small> "zechor Adonai livne edom et yom yerushalami". <small>(Zecharya 9 14)</small> " vaAdonai elohim bashshofar yitka vehalach besaarot teman". <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". <small>(Devarim 4 la)</small> "atta hareta ladaat" vechulei. <small>(Devarim 4 39)</small> "veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha" vechulei. kol pasuk meellu malchut hu inyano af al pi sheen bo zecher malchut vahare hu kemo <small>(Shemot 15 18)</small> "Adonai yimloch leolam vaed", <small>(Devarim 33 5)</small> "vayhi vishurun melech" vechulei:

Hamminhag happashut beseder hattekiot shel rosh hashshana betzibbur kach hu. achar shekkorin battora umachzirin hassefer limkomo yoshvin kol haam veechad omed umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lishmoa kol shofar vechol haam onin amen. vechozer umevarech shehecheyanu vechol haam onin acharav amen. vetokea sheloshim tekiot sheamarnu mippene hassafek al hasseder. veomrim kaddish veomdin umitpallelin tefillat musaf. veachar sheggomer sheliach tzibbur beracha reviit shehi malchuyyot tokea tekia shelosha shevarim terua tekia paam achat. umevarech beracha chamishit shehi zichronot. veachar sheggomrah tokea tekia shelosha shevarim utekia. umevarech beracha shishshit shehi shofarot. veachar sheggomrah tokea tekia terua utekia paam achat vegomer hattefilla:
Ze shettokea keshehen yoshvin hu shettokea al seder habberachot keshehen omdim. veeno medabber ben tekiot shemmeyushshav litkiot shemmeummad. veim sach benehen af al pi sheavar eno chozer umevarech:

Bedin haya sheyyitkeu al kol beracha kol bava mehen shalosh peamim kederech shettaku keshehen yoshvin ella kevan sheyyatzu mide safek battekiot shemmeyushshav en matrichin al hatztzibbur lachazor bahen kullan al seder berachot. ella day lahen bava achat al kol beracha kede sheyyishmeu tekiot al seder berachot. vechol haddevarim haellu betzibbur aval hayyachid ben sheshshama al seder berachot ben shello shama al hasseder ben meummad ben meyushshav yatza veen baze minhag:

Hattekiot enan meakkevot et habberachot vehabberachot enan meakkevot et hattekiot. shete ayarot beachat yodea bevadday sheyyesh sham mi sheyyevarech lahen tesha berachot veen sham tokea. uvashsheniyya safek yesh sham tokea safek en sham tokea holech lashsheniyya. shehattekia middivre tora vehabberachot middivre sofrim:

Shiur hassukka gavhah en pachot measara tefachim velo yater al esrim amma. verachbah en pachot mishshiva tefachim al shiva tefachim. veyesh lo lehosif berachbah afillu kamma milin. hayta pechuta measara o mishshiva al shiva o gevoha meesrim amma kol shehu hare zo pesula: 
Sukka sheen lah shalosh defanot pesula. hayu lah shete defanot gemurot zo betzad zo kemin gam ose dofen sheyyesh berachbo yeter al tefach umaamido befachot mishshelosha samuch leechad mishshete haddefanot vedayyo. vetzarich laasot lah tzurat petach mippene sheen lah shalosh dafnot gemurot. uchevar bearnu behilchot shabbat shetztzurat petach haamur bechol makom afillu kane mikkan vekane mikkan vekane al gabbehen af al pi sheeno maggia lahen: 
Hayu lah shete defanot zo keneged zo uvenehen mefullash. ose dofen sheyyesh berachbo arbaa tefachim umashshehu umaamido befachot mishshelosha samuch leachat mishshete haddefanot ucheshera. vetzarich laasot lah tzurat petach. kanim hayyotzim missechach hassukka lifne hassukka vedofen achat nimshechet immahen hare hen kesukka: 
Defanot shehayu devukot begag hassukka velo hayu maggiot laaretz im hayu gevohot min haaretz shelosha tefachim pesula. pachot mikken keshera. hayu haddefanot devukot laaretz velo hayu maggiot lassechach im gevohot asara tefachim af al pi shehen rechokin min haggag kamma ammot keshera uvilvad sheyyihyu haddefanot mechuvvanot tachat sefat haggag. hirchik et haggag min haddofen shelosha tefachim pesula. pachot mikken keshera. tala mechitztza sheggevoha arbaa umashshehu beemtza befachot mishshelosha samuch laaretz uvefachot mishshelosha samuch laggag hare zo keshera: 
Haose sukkato ben hailanot vehailanot defanot lah. im hayu chazakim o shekkashar otam vechizzek otam ad shello tihye haruach hammetzuya menida otam tamid umille ben haamirim beteven uvekash kede shello tanid otam haruach vekashar otam hare zo keshera. shekkol mechitztza sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya shel yabbasha enah mechitztza: 
Haose sukkato berosh haagala o berosh hassefina keshera veolin lah beyom tov. berosh hailan o al gabbe haggamal keshera veen olin lah beyom tov. lefi sheasur laalot beyom tov bailan o al gabbe behema. hayu miktzat haddefanot asuyot bide adam umiktzatan ilanot roin kol sheillu nittelu hailanot hi yechola laamod baddefanot shebbide adam olin lah beyom tov: 
Sukka sheen lah gag pesula. ketzad. kegon shehayu rashe haddefanot devukot zo bazo kemin tzerif. o shessamach rosh haddofen shel sukka lakkotel. im haya lah gag afillu tefach. o shehigbiah haddofen hassamuch lakkotel min hakkarka tefach hare zo keshera. sukka agulla im yesh behekkefah kede lerabbea bah shiva tefachim al shiva tefachim af al pi sheen lah zaviyyot hare zo keshera: 
Sikkech al gabbe achsadra sheyyesh lah petzimin ben shehayu nirin mibbifnim veen nirin mibbachutz ben shehayu nirin mibbachutz veen nirin mibbifnim keshera: 
Lo hayu lah petzimin pesula mippene shehi sukka haasuya kemavoy shehare en lah ella shene tzidde haachsadra veemtza haachsadra en bo kotel veshekkenegdo en bo petzimin: 
Sikkech al gabbe mavoy sheyyesh lo lechi o al gabbe beer sheyyesh lah passin hare zo sukka keshera leotah shabbat shebbetoch hechag bilvad. mittoch shellechi ze ufassin ellu mechitztzot leinyan shabbat nachshov otan kimchitztzot leinyan sukka: 
Naatz arbaa kundisin al arba zaviyyot haggag vesikkech al gabban hoil vehassikkuch al sefat haggag kasher veroin et hammechitztzot hattachtonot keillu hen olot lemala al sefat hassikkuch: 
Sukka sheyyesh lah petachim rabbim veyesh bichtaleha challonot harebe hare zo keshera. veaf al pi shepparutz merubbe al haomed. uvilvad shello yihye sham petach yeter al eser. aval im haya sham petach yeter al eser af al pi sheyyesh lah tzurat petach tzarich shello yihye happarutz merubbe al haomed: 
Sukka sheavirah gavoah meesrim amma umiatah becharim uchesatot eno miut vaafillu bittelam. miatah beteven uvittelo hare ze miut. veen tzarich lomar afar uvittelo. aval beafar setam eno miut. hayta gevoha meesrim amma vehutzin yordin letoch esrim im hayta tzillatan merubba mechamatan yechashvu kegag ave ucheshera: 
Bana itztabba bah keneged dofen haemtzait al pene kullah im yesh baitztabba shiur rochav hassukka keshera. bana itztabba keneged dofen haemtzait min hatztzad im yesh missefat itztabba velakkotel arba ammot pesula pachot mearba ammot keshera. bana itztabba beemtzaah im yesh missefat itztabba velakkotel arba ammot lechol ruach pesula. pachot mearba ammot keshera. ucheillu hammechitztzot nogot baitztabba vahare min haitztabba vead hassikkuch pachot meesrim amma. bana bah ammud veyesh bo hechsher sukka pesula. sheen ellu mechitztzot hannikkarot venimtza al gav haammud sechach kasher belo defanot: 
Hayta pechuta measara vechakak bah lehashelimah laasara. im yesh missefat chakak velakkotel shelosha tefachim pesula. pachot mikken keshera. shekkol pachot mishshelosha hare hu kedavuk kemo shebbearnu behilchot shabbat: 
Dafne sukka kesherin min hakkol sheen anu tzerichin ella mechitztza mikkol makom vaafillu mibbaale chayyim. veose adam et chavero dofen beyom tov kede sheyyochal veyishte veyishan besukka keshera shechavero dofen lah. vehu sheyyaase oto shello ledaat ze shennaasa dofen. aval im asahu ledaat asur beyom tov umuttar bishar yeme hechag. vechen ose bechelim dofen reviit beyom tov. aval dofen shelishit lo yaase otah bechelim beyom tov lefi shehu machshir hassukka veen osin ohel aray beyom tov:

Hasechach shel sukka eno kasher mikkol davar. en mesakkechin ella bedavar sheggiddulo min haaretz shenneekar min haaretz veeno mekabbel tuma veen recho ra veeno nosher veeno novel tamid: 
Sikkech bedavar sheen giddulav min haaretz o bimchubbar laaretz o bedavar shemmekabbel tuma pesula. aval im avar vesikkech bedavar hannovel venosher o bedavar sherecho ra keshera. shello amru en mesakkechin beellu ella kede shello yanniach hassukka veyetze. vetzarich lehizzaher shello yihyu hutzin vealin shel sechach yordin letoch asara tefachim kede shello yatzer lo bishivato. sikkechah bemine mattachot o baatzamot veorot pesula mippene sheenan giddule karka. hidla aleha gefanim vechayyotze bahen ad shennaasu sukka pesula shehare lo neekru. sikkechah bichle etz uvemachatzalot haasuyot lishchiva vechayyotze bahen pesula mippene shehen mekabbelin tuma. vechen im sikkechah beshivre kelim uveliyyotehen pesula hoil vehayu mekabbelin tuma shemma yesakkech bishvarim sheadayin lo taharu: 
Sikkechah boochalin pesula mippene shehen mekabbelin tuma. soche teenim uvahen teenim. parkile anavim uvahem anavim. michbadot uvahem temarim. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. roin im pesolet merubba al hoochalin mesakkechin bahen veim lav en mesakkechin bahen. sikkech birakot sheim yivoshu yibbolu velo yishshaer bahen mammash af al pi shehen atta lachim hare mekoman nechshav keillu hu avir ucheillu enam: 
Sikkechah befishte haetz shello dak otan velo nippetzan keshera sheadayin etz hu. veim dak venippetz otan en mesakkechin bo mippene shennishtannet tzurato ucheillu enan miggiddule karka. mesakkechin bachavalim shel siv veshel chalaf vechayyotze bahen shehare tzuratan omed veen hachavalim kelim: 
Sikkechah bechitztzim bizcharim keshera binkevot pesula af al pi shehu asuy lehitmalleot bevarzel bet kibbul hu umekabbel tuma kechol keli kibbul: 
Machtzelet kanim o machtzelet gemi o chalaf. ketanna setama lishchiva lefichach en mesakkechin bah ella im ken asa otah lesikkuch. gedola setama lesikkuch lefichach mesakkechin bah ella im ken asa otah lishchiva. veim yesh lah kir afillu gedola en mesakkechin bah shehare hi kichli kibbul. vaafillu nittal hakkir shellah en mesakkechin bah mippene shehi keshivre kelim: 
Nesarim sheen berachban arbaa tefachim mesakkechin bahen af al pi shehen meshuppin. veim yesh berachban arbaa en mesakkechin bahen veaf al pi sheenam meshuppin gezera shemma yeshev tachat hattikra vidamme shehi kesukka. natan aleha neser echad sheyyesh berachbo arbaa tefachim keshera veen yeshenin tachtav vehayyashen tachtav lo yatza yede chovato. hayu nesarin sheyyesh berachban arbaa veen beavyan arbaa vahafachan betziddehen sheen bahen arbaa vesikkech bahen hare zo pesula. shehare hanneser pasul ben shessikkech berachbo ben shessikkech beavyo: 
Tikra sheen aleha maaziva shehi hattit vehaavanim ella nesarin tekuin bilvad hare zo pesula shehare lo naasu leshem sukka ella leshem bayit. lefichach im pikpek hannesarim vehenid hammasmerim leshem sukka hare zo keshera. uvilvad shello yihye bechol neser veneser arbaa tefachim. vechen im natal echad mibbentayim vehinniach bimkomo sechach kasher leshem sukka hare zo keshera: 
Sukka shennaaset kehilchatah mikkol makom keshera af al pi shello naaset leshem mitzva. vehu shettihye asuya letzel kegon sukkat akkum vesukkat behema vechol kayyotze bahen. aval sukka shennaaset meeleha pesula lefi shello naaset letzel. vechen hachotet begadish veasahu sukka enah sukka shehare lo immer gadish ze letzel. lefichach im asa battechilla chalal tefach bemeshech shiva leshem sukka vechatat bah achare chen vehishlimah laasara keshera shehare naasa sechach shellah letzel: 
Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradin en mesakkechin bahen gezera shemma yaase otan chavilot al gaggo kede leyabbeshan veyimmalech veyeshev tachtehen leshem sukka vehu mittechilla lo asa sechach ze letzel venimtzet kesukka shennaaset meeleha. veim hittiram kesherot. veen chavila pechuta meesrim vachamishsha baddim: 
Chavilot ketannot sheagdu otan leminyan mesakkechin bahen. vechen hachotech rosh haddekel vehacharayot aguddot bo mesakkechin bo sheeged bide shamayim eno kachavila. vaafillu kashar rashe hacharayot kullan mitztzad haechad shennimtzeu bachavila achat echad mishshene rashim bide shamayim veechad bide adam mesakkechin bah shehaoged etz echad eno chavila vezo keetz echad hi shehare aguda bide shamayim. vechen kol eged sheeno asuy letaltelo eno eged: 
Haose sukkato tachat hailan keillu asaah betoch habbayit. hidla aleha ale hailanot uvaddehen vesikkech al gabban veachar kach katztzan. im haya hassikkuch harebe mehen keshera. veim lo haya hassikkuch shehaya mittechillato kasher harebe mehen tzarich lenaanea otan achar ketzitzatan kede shettihye asuya leshem sukka: 
Erev davar shemmesakkechin bo bedavar sheen mesakkechin bo vesikkech bishnehem af al pi shehakkasher yater al happasul pesula. sikkech baze leatzmo uvaze leatzmo ze betzad ze. im yesh bassechach pasul shelosha tefachim bemakom echad ben baemtza ben min hatztzad hare zo pesula: 
Bamme devarim amurim besukka ketanna aval besukka gedola sechach pasul baemtza poslah bearbaa tefachim. pachot mikken keshera. umin hatztzad posel bearba ammot ufachot mikken keshera. ketzad. bayit shennifchat beemtzao vesikkech al mekom happechat. vechen chatzer hammukkefet achsadra shessikkech aleha. vechen sukka gedola shehikkifuha bedavar sheen mesakkechin bo betzad haddefanot millemala. im yesh missefat hassechach hakkasher velakkotel arba ammot pesula. pachot mikken roin keillu hakkotel neekam veyechashev ze hassechach happasul migguf hakkotel ucheshera. vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay: 
Vee zo hi sukka ketanna kol sheen bah ella shiva tefachim al shiva tefachim. ugedola kol sheyyishshaer bah yeter al sechach happasul shiva tefachim al shiva tefachim sechach kasher: 
Sikkech bedavar pasul vedavar kasher ze betzad ze veen bemakom echad missechach happasul rochav shelosha tefachim ella pachot. im haya kol hassechach hakkasher yoter al kol hassechach happasul kasher. veim haya ze kemo ze betzimtzum af al pi sheen bemakom echad shelosha hare zo pesula mippene shessechach pasul kefarutz hu nechshav: 
Paras aleha beged millemala o shepparas tachteha mippene hannesher pesula. peraso kede lenaotah keshera. vechen im sikkechah kehilchatah veitterah bemine perot uvemine megadim vechelim shetteluyin ben bichtaleha ben bassechach kede lenaotah keshera: 
Noye sukka en memaatin begavhah aval memaatin berachbah. hayu noye hassukka muflagin miggaggah arbaa tefachim o yeter pesula. shennimtza hayyoshev sham keillu eno tachat hassechach ella tachat hannoyim shehen ochalin vechelim sheen mesakkechin bahen: 
Sechach shehayu bo challonot challonot shehaavir nire mehen. im yesh bechol haavir kechol makom hamesukkach hare zo pesula mippene shechammatah tihye merubba mitztzillatah. vechol shehachamma merubba al hatztzel eno sechach. veim haya hassechach rav al haavir keshera: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshello haya bemakom echad avir shelosha tefachim. aval im haya avir shelosha tefachim ben baemtza ben min hatztzad hare zo pesula ad sheyyemaatennu mishshelosha. miato bedavar happasul kegon karim uchesatot. im sukka gedola hi keshera. veim besukka ketanna pesula ad sheyyemaatennu bedavar shemmesakkechin bo. haya rov hassikkuch tzillato merubbe mechamato umiuto chamato merubbe mitztzillato hoil vetzillat hakkol merubba mechamat hakkol keshera: 
Derech hassikkuch lihyot kal kede sheyyerau mimmennu hakkochavim haggedolim. hayta meubba kemin bayit af al pi sheen hakkochavim nirin mittochah keshera. haya hassikkuch meduvlal vehu hassikkuch sheyyihye miktzato lemala umiktzato lematta kasher. uvilvad shello yihye ben haole vehayyored shelosha tefachim. veim haya berochav ze haole tefach o yeter af al pi shehu gavoah yeter mishshelosha tefachim roin oto keillu yarad lematta venaga bisfat ze hayyored. vehu sheyyihye mechuvvan keneged sefat hayyored: 
Haose sukka al gabbe sukka. hattachtona pesula kemi sheasa sukka betoch habbayit vehaelyona keshera bamme devarim amurim shehattachtona pesula beshehaya gova chalal haelyona asara tefachim o yeter vehaya gag hattachtona yachol lekabbel karim uchesatot shel elyona afillu al yede haddechak. aval im en gavhah shel elyona asara o shello hayta hattachtona yechola lekabbel karim uchesatot shel elyona afillu al yede haddechak (af) hattachtona keshera vehu shello yihye gova shetehen yeter al esrim amma shehattachtona bassechach haelyona hi nitteret: 
Mitta shebbetoch hassukka im gevoha asara tefachim. hayyoshev tachteha lo yatza yede chovato. mippene shehi kesukka betoch sukka. vechen killa sheyyesh lah gag afillu tefach im gevoha asara tefachim en yeshenin bah bassukka. vechen hammaamid arbaa ammudim ufaras sadin alehen im gevohin asara hare zo kesukka betoch sukka: 
Aval shene ammudim shepparas alehen sadin vechen killa sheen begaggah tefach afillu gevohin kol shehen muttar lishon tachtehem besukka. sheenan kesukka betoch sukka mippene sheen lah gag: 
Sukka sheula keshera vechen haggezula keshera. ketzad. im takaf al chavero vehotzio missukkato ugezalah veyashav bah yatza sheen hakkarka nigzelet. veim gazal etzim veasa mehen sukka yatza. shettakkanat chachamim hi sheen levaal haetzim ella deme etzim bilvad. vaafillu gazal nesarim vehinnichan velo chibberan velo shana bahen kelum yatza. haose sukkato birshut harabbim hare zo keshera:

Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim min hassukka. tumtum veanderoginus chayyavim missafek. vechen mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin chayyav. katan sheeno tzarich leimmo shehu [keven chamesh] keven shesh chayyav besukka middivre sofrim kede lechannecho bemitzvot:

Cholim umeshammeshehen peturim min hassukka. velo chole sheyyesh bo sakkana ella afillu chash berosho vaafillu chash beenav. mitztaer patur min hassukka hu velo meshammeshav. veezehu mitztaer ze sheeno yachol lishon bassukka mippene haruach o mippene hazzevuvim vehapparoshim vechayyotze bahen o mippene hareach:
Haavel chayyav besukka. vechatan vechol hashshoshvinin vechol bene chuppa peturim min hassukka kol shivat yeme hammishte:

Sheluche mitzva peturim min hassukka ben bayyom uven ballayla. holche derachim bayyom peturim min hassukka bayyom vechayyavin ballayla. holche derachim ballayla peturim min hassukka ballayla vechayyavim bayyom. shomre hair bayyom peturim min hassukka bayyom vechayyavim ballayla. shomre hair ballayla peturim min hassukka ballayla vechayyavim bayyom. shomre ginnot ufardesin peturin ben bayyom uven ballayla sheim yaase hashshomer sukka yeda haggannav sheyyesh lashshomer makom kavua veyavo veyignov min makom acher:

Ketzad hi mitzvat hayeshiva bassukka. sheyyihye ochel veshote vedar bassukka kol shivat hayyamim ben bayyom uven ballayla kederech shehu dar beveto bishar yemot hashshana. vechol shivat hayyamim ose adam et beto aray veet sukkato keva shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 42)</small> "bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim". ketzad. kelim hannaim umatztzaot hannaot bassukka. uchele shetiyya kegon ashishot vechosot bassukka. aval kele achila kegon kederot ukearot chutz lasukka. hammenora bassukka. veim hayta sukka ketanna mannichah chutz lassukka:

Ochlin veshotin vishenim bassukka kol shiva ben bayyom uven ballayla. veasur leechol seudda chutz lasukka kol shiva ella im achal achilat aray kevetza o pachot o yeter meat. veen yeshenim chutz lasukka afillu shenat aray. umuttar lishtot mayim veleechol perot chutz lassukka. umi sheyyachamir al atzmo velo yishte chutz lasukka afillu mayim hare ze meshubbach:

Achila belele yom tov harishon bassukka chova. afillu achal kezayit pat yatza yede chovato. mikkan veelach reshut. ratza leechol seudda soed bassukka. ratza eno ochel kol shiva ella perot o kelayot chutz lassukka ochel kedin achilat matztza befesach:

Mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch beto o chutz lassukka veochel hare ze asur ucheillu lo achal bassukka ad sheyyihye shulchano betoch hassukka. gezera shemma yimmashech achar shulchano. vaafillu besukka gedola:
Kol shivat hayyamim kore betoch hassukka. ucheshemmevin umedakdek bema sheyyikra yavin chutz lasukka kede shettihye dato meyushshevet alav. hammitpallel ratza mitpallel bassukka o chutz lassukka:

Yardu geshamim hare ze nichnas letoch habbayit. meematay muttar lippanot, mishsheyyardu letoch hassukka tippot sheim yippelu letoch hattavshil yippasel, afillu tavshil shel pol. haya ochel bassukka veyardu geshamim venichnas leveto ufasku haggeshamim en mechayyevim oto lachazor lassukka (kol oto hallayla) ad sheyyigmor seuddato. haya yashen veyardu geshamim ballayla venichnas letoch habbayit ufasku haggeshamim en matrichin oto lachazor lasukka kol oto hallayla ella yashen beveto ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar:

Gamar milleechol bayyom hashshevii beshacharit lo yattir sukkato. aval morid hu et kelav umefanne otan min hammincha ulemala. en lo makom lefannot pochet bah arbaa al arbaa. veim hutzrach lisod bishar hayyom tzarich leechol bassukka, shemmitzvatah kol shiva:

Kol zeman sheyyikkanes leshev bassukka kol shiva mevarech kodem sheyyeshev asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu leshev bassukka. uvelele yom tov harishon mevarech al hassukka veachar kach al hazzeman. umesadder kol habberachot al hakkos. nimtza mekaddesh meummad umevarech leshev bassukka veyoshev veachar kach mevarech al hazzeman. vechaze haya minhag rabbotay verabbane sefarad lekaddesh meemmad belayil rishon shel chag hassukkot kemo shebbearnu:

Bazzeman hazze sheanu osin shene yamim tovim. yoshvin bassukka shemona yamim. uvayyom hashshemini shehu yom tov rishon shel shemini atzeret yoshvin bah veen mevarchin leshev bassukka. vechen tumtum veanderoginus leolam en mevarchin leshev bassukka mippene shehen chayyavim missafek veen mevarchin missafek:

Gamar milleechol bayyom hashshemini morid kelav umefanne otah. en lo makom lehorid et kelav im hayta ketanna machnis bah menora. veim hayta gedola machnis bah kederot ukearot vechayyotze bahen kede lehazekir shehi pesula veshekkevar nigmera mitzvatah umippene shehu yom tov eno yachol lifchot bah ulefaslah:

Mi shello asa sukka ben beshogeg ben bemezid ose sukka bechullo shel moed. afillu besof yom shevii ose sukka, shemmitzvatah kol shiva. atze sukka asurin kol shemonat yeme hechag ben atze defanot ben atze sechach en neotin mehen ledavar acher kol shemonat hayyamim mippene sheyyom hashshevii kullo hassukka muktza ad ben hashshemashot vehoil vehuktzat leven hashshemashot shel shemini huktzat lechol hayyom:

Vechen ochalin umashkin shettolin bassukka kede lenaotah asur lehistappek mehen kol shemona. veim hitna alehen beshaa shettelaan veamar eni bodel mehen kol ben hashshemashot hare ze mistappek mehen bechol et sheyyirtze. shehare lo hiktza otam velo chala alehen kedushshat hassukka velo nechshevu kemotah:

<small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "kappot temarim" haamurot battora hen charayot shel dekel kesheyyitzmechu kodem sheyyitpardu healin shellahen lechan ulechan ella kesheyyihye kemo sharvit. vehu hannikra lulav: 
<small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "peri etz hadar" haamur battora hu etrog. <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "vaanaf etz avot" haamur battora hu hahadas shealav chofin et etzo. kegon sheyyihyu shelosha alin o yeter al ken begivol echad. aval im hayu shene healin beshave ze keneged ze veheale hashshelishi lemala mehen en ze avot aval nikra hadas shote: 
<small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "arve nachal" haamurot battora enan kol davar haggadel al hannachal ella min yadua hu hannikra arve nachal. ale shello mashuch kenachal ufiv chalak vekane shello adom veze hu hannikra arava. verov min ze gadel al hannechalim lechach neemar arve nachal. vaafillu haya gadel bammidbar o beharim kasher: 
Veyesh min acher dome laarava ella sheale shello agol ufiv dome lemassar vekane shello eno adom vezehu hannikra tzaftzafa vehi pesula. veyesh sham min arava sheen pi heale shellah chalak veeno kemassar ella yesh bo telamim ketannim ad meod kemo pi maggal katan veze kasher. vechol haddevarim haellu mippi hashshemua mimmoshe rabbenu nitparshu: 
Arbaa minin ellu mitzva achat hen umeakkevin ze et ze vechullan nikraim mitzvat lulav. veen pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen. veim lo nimtza echad mehen en meviim tachtav min acher haddome lo: 
Mitzva min hammuvchar leegod lulav vahadas vaarava velaasot shelashtan agudda achat. ucheshehu notlam latzet bahen mevarech techilla al netilat lulav hoil vechullan semuchin lo veachar kach notel haagudda hazzot bimino veetrog bismolo venotlan derech gedilatan sheyyihyu ikkerehen lematta laaretz verashehen lemala laavir. veim lo agadan unetalan echad echad yatza vehu sheyyihyu arbatan metzuyin etzlo. aval im lo haya lo ella min echad o shechaser min echad lo yittol ad sheyyimtza hashshear: 
Kamma notel mehen. lulav echad veetrog echad ushene badde arava ushelosha badde hadas. veim ratza lehosif bahadas kede shettihye agudda gedola mosif. venoye mitzva hu. aval shear hamminin en mosifin al minyanam veen gorin mehen. veim hosif o gara (pasul): 
Kamma shiur orech kol min mehem. lulav en pachot mearbaa tefachim veim haya aroch kol shehu kasher. umedidato mishshidrato bilvad lo merosh healim. vahadas vaarava en pachot mishshelosha tefachim. veim hayu arukkin kol shehen kesherim. vaafillu en bechol bad uvad ella shelosha alin lachin kesherim vehu sheyyihyu berosh habbad. veim agad hallulav tzarich sheyyihye shedero shel lulav yotze min hahadas vaarava tefach o yoter. veshiur etrog en pachot mikkevetza veim haya gadol kol shehu kasher: 
Mishsheyyagbiah arbaa minin ellu ben shehigbihan keachat ben baze achar ze ben beyamin ben bismol yatza. vehu sheyyagbihan derech gedilatan. aval shello derech gedilatan lo yatza. umitzva kehilchatah sheyyagbiah agudda shel shelosha minin beyamin veetrog bismol veyolich veyavi veyaale veyorid vinaanea hallulav shelosha peamim bechol ruach veruach: 
Ketzad. molich umenanea rosh hallulav shalosh peamim umevi umenanea rosh hallulav shalosh peamim vechen baaliyya virida. vehechan molich umevi. bishat keriat hahallel b <small>(Tehillim 118 1)</small> <small>(Tehillim 118 29)</small> "hodu laAdonai ki tov" techilla vasof uv<small>(Tehillim 118 25)</small> "anna Adonai hoshia na". vechol hayyom kasher lintilat lulav veeno notel ballayla: 
Asa laagudda zo gimon shel kesef veshel zahav o shekkarach aleha sadin unetalah yatza. lekicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha. vehu sheyyihye derech kavod vederech hiddur shekkol shehu lenaoto eno chotzetz. aval im natan et hamminin haellu beatzitz o bikdera unetalah lo yatza yede chovato: 
Agad et hallulav im hahadas vehaarava vehivdil ben hallulav uven hahadas bematlat vechayyotze bah hare ze chotzetz. hivdil benehen baale hadas eno chotzetz. shemmin bemino eno chotzetz. veyesh lo leegod et hallulav bechut o bimshicha uvechol min sheyyirtze hoil veen agidato meakkev: 
Mitzvat lulav lehinnatel beyom rishon shel chag bilvad bechol makom uvechol zeman vaafillu beshabbat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon". uvammikdash levaddo notlin oto bechol yom vayom mishshivat yeme hechag shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem" vegomer. chal yom hashshabbat lihyot betoch yeme hechag eno nittal beshabbat gezera shemma yolichennu beyado arba ammot birshut harabbim kemo sheggazru beshofar: 
Velamma lo gazru gezera zo beyom tov harishon mippene shehu mitzva min hattora vaafillu bigvulin. nimtza sheen dino vedin shear hayyamim shave shebbishar yeme hechag en adam chayyav littol lulav ella bammikdash: 
Mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkinu sheyyihye lulav nittal bechol makom kol shivat yeme hechag zecher lammikdash. vechol yom vayom mevarech alav asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat lulav mippene shehi mitzva middivre sofrim. vetakkana zo im kol hattakkanot shehitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay mishshecharav bet hammikdash kesheyyibbane bet hammikdash yachzeru haddevarim leyashnan: 
Bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam haya lulav nittal bayyom harishon shechal lihyot beshabbat. vechen bishar hammekomot sheyyadu bevadday sheyyom ze hu yom hechag beeretz yisrael. aval hammekomot harchokim shello hayu yodim bikviut rosh chodesh lo hayu notlin hallulav missafek: 
Umishshecharav bet hammikdash asru chachamim littol et hallulav beshabbat bayyom harishon vaafillu bene eretz yisrael shekkiddeshu et hachodesh. mippene bene haggevulin harchokim sheenan yodin bikviat hachodesh. kede sheyyihyu hakkol shavin bedavar ze velo yihyu ellu notlin beshabbat veellu en notlin. hoil vechiyyuv yom rishon bechol makom echad hu veen sham mikdash lehittalot bo: 
Uvazzeman hazze shehakkol osin al pi hacheshbon nishar haddavar kemot shehaya shello yinnatel lulav beshabbat kelal lo bigvulin velo beeretz yisrael vaafillu beyom rishon. veaf al pi shehakkol yodim bikviat hachodesh. uchevar bearnu sheikkar haissur bintilat hallulav beshabbat gezera shemma yaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim: 
Kol shechayyav beshofar uvesukka chayyav bintilat hallulav. vechol happatur mishshofar vesukka patur minnetilat lulav. katan hayyodea lenaanea chayyav belulav middivre sofrim kede lechannecho bemitzvot: 
Halacha lemoshe missinay shemmeviin bammikdash arava acheret chutz mearava shebballulav. veen adam yotze yede chovato baarava shebballulav. veshiurah afillu ale echad bevad echad: 
Ketzad hayta mitzvatah. bechol yom vayom mishshivat hayyamim hayu meviin murbiyyot shel arava vezokfin otan al tzidde hammizbeach verashehen kefufin al gabbe hammizbeach. uveet shehayu meviin otah vesodrin otah tokin umeriin vetokin. chal yom shabbat lihyot betoch hechag en zokfin arava ella im ken chal yom shevii lihyot beshabbat zokfin otah beshabbat kede lefarsemah shehi mitzva: 
Ketzad hayu osin. meviin otah meerev shabbat lammikdash umannichin otah begiggiyyot shel zahav kede shello yichmeshu healin. ulemachar zokfin otah al gabbe hammizbeach uvain haam velokchin mimmenna venotlin otah kederech sheosin bechol yom. vaarava zo hoil veenah beferush battora en notlin otah kol shivat yeme hechag zecher lammikdash ella bayyom hashshevii bilvad hu shennotlin otah bazzeman hazze. ketzad ose. lokeach bad echad o baddin harebe chutz mearava shebballulav vechovet bah al hakkarka o al hakkeli paamayim o shalosh belo beracha sheddavar ze minhag neviim hu: 
Bechol yom vayom hayu makkifin et hammizbeach belulevehen bidehen paam achat veomrin <small>(Tehillim 118 25)</small> "anna Adonai hoshia na". <small>(Tehillim 118 25)</small> "anna Adonai hatzelicha na". uvayyom hashshevii makkifin et hammizbeach sheva peamim. uchevar nahagu yisrael bechol hammekomot lehanniach teva beemtza bet hakkeneset umakkifin otah bechol yom kederech shehayu makkifin et hammizbeach zecher lammikdash: 
Kach haya hamminhag birushalayim. yotze adam mibbeto shacharit velulavo beyado. venichnas levayit hakkeneset vehu beyado. mitpallel vehu beyado. veyotze levakker cholim ulenachem avelim vehu beyado. uchesheyyikkanes lammidrash meshallecho leveto beyad beno o beyad avdo: 
Mekabbelet ishsha hallulav miyyad benah o miyyad balah umachzirato lammayim beshabbat bizman shehayu notlin lulav beshabbat. uveyom tov mosifin al hammayim uvammoed machlifin hammayim: 
Hadas shebballulav asur lehariach bo mippene sheeno rauy ella lereach vehoil vehuktza lemitzva asur lehariach bo. aval etrog muttar lehariach bo shehare huktza lemitzva meachila: 
Veasur leechol etrog kol yom hashshevii mippene shehuktza lemiktzat hayyom huktza lechullo. uvashshemini muttar baachila. uvazzeman hazze sheanu osin shene yamim af al pi sheen notlin lulav bashshemini haetrog asur bashshemini kederech shehaya asur bashshemini bizman shehayu osin shene yamim mippene hassafek shehu sefek shevii. hifrish shiva etrogin leshivat yamim kol achat veachat yotze bah leyomah veochlah lemachar:

Arvaat minin haellu shehen lulav vahadas vaarava veetrog shehaya echad mehen yavesh o gazul o ganuv afillu leachar yeush o sheyyihye meashera hanneevedet af al pi shebbittelu haashera milleavdah. o shehaya shel ir hanniddachat. hare ze pasul. haya echad mehen shel avodat kochavim lo yittol lechattechilla veim natal yatza. haya kamush velo gamar livash kasher. uvishat haddechak o bishat hassakkana lulav hayyavesh kasher aval lo shear hamminin:

Etrog shel arla veshel teruma temea veshel tevel pasul. shel demay kasher sheefshar sheyyafkir nechasav veyihye ani shemmuttar lo leechol demay. etrog shel teruma tehora veshel maaser sheni birushalayim lo yittol shemma yachshiro letuma. veim natal kasher:

Lulav shenniktam rosho pasul. nisdak im nitrachaku shene sedakav ze mizze ad sheyyerau kishnayim pasul. haya akum lefanav shehare shedero kegav baal chatoteret pasul. haya akum laachorav kasher shezzo hi beriyyato. neekam leechad mitztzedadav pasul. nifredu alav ze meal ze velo niddaldelu kaale hacharayot kasher. nifretzu alav vehu sheyyiddaldelu mishshedero shel lulav kaale hacharayot pasul:

Beriyyat alin shel lulav kach hi. keshehem gedelin gedelin shenayim shenayim udevukin miggabban vegav kol shene alin haddevukin hu hannikra teyomet. nechleka hatteyomet pasul. hayu alav achat achat mittechillat beriyyato vlo haya lahem teyomet pasul. lo hayu alav ze al gav ze kederech kol hallulavin ella ze tachat ze im rosh ze maggia laikkar shellemala mimmennu ad shennimtza kol shedero shel lulav mechusse bealin kasher. veim en rosho shel ze maggia letzad ikkaro shel ze pasul:

Hadas shenniktam rosho kasher. nashru rov alav im nishtayyeru shelosha alin beken echad kasher. hayu anavav merubbot mealav im yerukkot kasher veim adummot o shechorot pasul. veim miatan kasher. veen memaatin otan beyom tov lefi shehu kimtakken. avar velikketan o shellikketan echad echad laachila hare ze kasher:
Arava shenniktam roshah keshera. nifretzu aleha pesula:

Etrog shennikkav nekev mefullash kol shehu pasul. vesheeno mefullash im haya keisar o yeter pasul. chaser kol shehu pasul. nittal dado vehu harosh hakkatan sheshshoshanto bo pasul. nittal haetz shehu taluy bo bailan meikkar haetrog venishar mekomo guma pasul. alta chazazit alav im bishnayim ushelosha mekomot pasul. veim bemakom echad im alta al rubbo pasul. veim al dado vaafillu kol shehu pasul. niklaf hakkerum hachitzona shello sheeno mechassero ella nishar yarok kemot shehi beriyyato im niklaf kullo pasul veim nishar mimmennu kol shehu kasher:

Etrog shehu tafuach saruach kavush shaluk shachor lavan menummar yarok kecharti pasul. giddelo bidfus veasahu kemin beriyya acheret pasul. asahu kemin beriyyato af al pi sheasahu dappin dappin kasher. hattiom vehabboser kasher. makom shehaetrogin shellahem keen shacharut meuta kesherin. veim hayu shechorim beyoter keadam kushi hare ze pasul bechol makom:

Kol ellu sheamarnu shehem pesulin mippene mumin shebbearnu o mippene gezel ugeneva beyom tov rishon bilvad aval beyom tov sheni im shear hayyamim hakkol kasher. vehappaslanut shehu mishshum avodat kochavim o mippene sheoto etrog asur baachila ben beyom tov rishon ben bishar yamim pasul:

En adam yotze beyom tov rishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero sheyyishalennu mimmennu ad sheyyittenennu lo bemattana. netano lo al menat lehachaziro hare ze yotze bo yede chovato umachaziro. shemmattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana. veim lo hechziro lo yatza shennimtza kegazul. veen notnin oto lekatan shehakkatan kone veeno makne laacherim min hattora venimtza sheim hechziro lo eno chozer. veechad hallulav veechad kol min vamin mearba minin shebbo im haya echad mehen shaul en yotzin bo beyom tov rishon:

Shuttafin shekkanu lulav o etrog beshuttafut en echad mehen yotze bo yede chovato barishon ad sheyyitten lo chelko bemattana. haachin shekkanu etrogin mittefisat habbayit venatal echad mehen etrog veyatza bo. im yachol leachlo veen haachin makpidin bechach yatza. veim hayu makpidin lo yatza ad sheyyittenu lo chelkam bemattana. veim kana ze etrog veze parish o shekkanu keechad etrog verimmon ufarish mittefisat habbayit eno yotze baetrog ad sheyyitten lo chelko bemattana veaf al pi sheim achalo en makpidin alav:

Af al pi shekkol hammoadot mitzva lismoach bahen. bechag hassukkot hayta bammikdash yom simcha yetera shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 40)</small> "usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim". vechetzad hayu osin. erev yom tov harishon hayu metakkenin bammikdash makom lannashim millemala velaanashim millematta kede shello yitarvu ellu im ellu. umatchilin lismoach mimmotzae yom tov harishon. vechen bechol yom veyom mime chullo shel moed matchilin meachar sheyyakrivu tamid shel ben haarbayim lismoach lishar hayyom im kol hallayla:

Veheach hayta simcha zo. hechalil makke umenaggenin bechinnor uvinvalim uvimtziltayim vechol echad veechad bichle shir shehu yodea lenaggen bo. umi sheyyodea bappe bappe. verokdin umesappekin umetappechin umefazzezin umecharkerin kol echad veechad kemo sheyyodea veomrim divre shirot vetushbachot. vesimcha zo enah docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov:

Mitzva leharebot besimcha zo. velo hayu osin otah amme haaretz vechol mi sheyyirtze. ella gedole chachme yisrael verashe hayeshivot vehassanhedrin vehachasidim vehazzekenim veanshe maase hem shehayu merakkedin umesappekin umenaggenin umesammechin bammikdash bime chag hassukkot. aval kol haam haanashim vehannashim kullan bain lirot velishmoa:

Hassimcha sheyyismach adam baasiyyat hammitzva uveahavat hael shetztzivva bahen. avoda gedola hi. vechol hammonea atzmo missimcha zo rauy lehippara mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav". vechol hammegis dato vecholek kavod leatzmo umitkabbed beenav bimkomot ellu chote veshote. veal ze hizhir shelomo veamar <small>(Mishlei 25 6)</small> "al tithaddar lifne melech". vechol hammashpil atzmo umekel gufo bimkomot ellu hu haggadol hamechubbad haoved meahava. vechen david melech yisrael amar <small>(Shmuel 2 6 22)</small> "unekalloti od mizzot vehayiti shafal beenay". veen haggedulla vehakkavod ella lismoach lifne Adonai shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 6 16)</small> "vehammelech david mefazzez umecharker lifne Adonai": salik hilchot shoppar sukka velulav
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 1:
<small>(Shemot 21 2)</small> "eved ivri" haamur battora ze yisreeli shemmachru oto bet din al karcho o hammocher atzmo lirtzono. ketzad. ganav veen lo leshallem et hakkeren bet din mochrin oto kemo sheamarnu behilchot geneva. veen lecha ish beyisrael shemmochrin oto bet din ella haggannav bilvad. veal ze shemmecharuhu bet din hu omer <small>(Shemot 21 2)</small> "ki tikne eved ivri". vealav hu omer bemishne tora <small>(Devarim 15 12)</small> "ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri". mocher atzmo ketzad. ze yisrael sheheeni beyoter natna lo tora reshut limkor et atzmo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 39)</small> "ki yamuch achicha immach venimkar lecha". veeno rashshay limkor et atzmo ulehatznia et damav o liknot bahem sechora o kelim o littenem levaal chov ella im ken tzarich leachlan bilvad. veen adam rashshay limkor et atzmo ad shello yishshaer lo kelum vaafillu kesut lo tishshaer lo veachar kach yimkor et atzmo: 
Kevar bearnu sheen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah vechen enah mocheret et atzmah veenah kona lo eved ivri velo eved kenaani mippene hachashad. veen hagger nikne beeved ivri shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veshav el mishpachto" mi sheyyesh lo mishpacha: 
Eved ivri shemmecharuhu bet din en mochrin oto ella leyisrael o leger tzedek. vechen hammocher atzmo eno rashshay limkor atzmo leakkum vaafillu leger toshav. veim avar umachar atzmo afillu leakkum vaafillu laavodat kochavim atzmah hare ze machur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 47)</small> "o leeker mishpachat ger". leeker ze hannimkar laavodat kochavim atzmah: 
Ba veamar lecha hareni mocher atzmi leakkum en atta zakuk lo ad sheyyimmacher aval leachar shennimkar leakkum af al pi sheavar veasa shello kahogen mitzva lifdoto velo yittama bahem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 48)</small> "achare nimkar geulla tihye lo": 
Echad hammocher et atzmo o shemmecharuhu bet din eno nimkar befarhesya al even hammikkach velo besimta kederech shehaavadim nimkarin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 42)</small> "lo yimmachru mimkeret aved" eno nimkar ella betzina vederech kavod: 
Kol eved ivri asur laavod bo befarech. veezo hi avodat parech zo avoda sheen lah kitzva vaavoda sheeno tzarich lah ella tihye machshavto lehaavido bilvad shello yibbatel. mikkan amru chachamim shello yomar lo ador tachat haggefanim ad sheavo shehare lo natan lo kitzva. ella yomar lo ador ad shaa pelonit o ad makom peloni. vechen lo yomar lo chafor makom ze vehu eno tzarich lo. vaafillu lehachem lo kos shel chammin o lehatzen veeno tzarich lo asur veover alav belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 43)</small> "lo tirde vo befarech". ha eno ose lo ella davar katzuv shehu tzarich lo. vechen haakkum shennimkar lo im rada bo befarech hare yisrael metzuvvin lemano. veim hinnichuhu ovrim belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 53)</small> "lo yirdennu beferech leenecha". veen anu nizkakin lichnos lirshuto shel akkum velivdok acharav shello yaavidennu befarech shenneemar leenecha bizman sheatta roe: 
Kol eved ivri asur leyisrael shekkanahu lehaavido bidvarim bozim shehem meyuchadim laasot haavadim kegon sheyyolich acharav kelav levet hammerchatz o yachlotz lo minalav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 39)</small> "lo taavod bo avodat aved". eno noheg bo ella kesachir shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "kesachir ketoshav yihye immach". umuttar lesapper lo searo ulechabbes lo kesuto veleefot lo issato. aval lo yaase oto ballan larabbim o sappar larabbim o nachtom larabbim. veim hayta ummanuto zot kodem sheyyimmacher hare ze yaase. aval lo yelammedenu battechilla melacha kelal ella ummanut shehaya bah hu sheose keshehaya ose mikkodem. bamme devarim amurim beeved ivri mippene shennafsho shefala bimchira. aval yisrael shello nimkar muttar lehishtammesh bo keeved shehare eno ose melacha zo ella birtzono umiddaat atzmo: 
Anashim sheenan nohagin kashshura muttar lirdotan bechazka ulehishtabed bahen. melech sheggazar shekkol mi shello yitten hammas hakkatzuv al kol ish veish yishtabed leze shennatan hammas al yado hare ze muttar lehishtammesh bo yoter midday aval lo keeved. veim eno noheg kashshura muttar lehishtammesh bo keeved: 
Kol eved ivri o ama haivriyya chayyav haadon lehashevotan lo bemaachol uvemashke bichsut uvemador shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 16)</small> "ki tov lo immach" shello tehe atta ochel pat naki vehu ochel pat kibbar atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash atta yashen al gabbe mochin vehu yashen al gabbe hatteven atta dar bichrach vehu dar bichfar o atta dar bichfar vehu yoshev bichrach. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veyatza meimmach". mikkan amru kol hakkone eved ivri kekone adon leatzmo. vechayyav linhog bo minhag achva shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 46)</small> "uveachechem bene yisrael". veaf al pi chen tzarich haeved linhog beatzmo minhag avdut beotan haavodot shehu ose lo: 
En ama haivriyya noheget velo eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg. ben eved ivri shemmocher atzmo ben ze shemmecharuhu bet din. uchevar bearnu matay batlu hayyovlot:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 2:
Eved ivri shemmecharuhu bet din [vehammocher atzmo] nikne bechesef uvishve kesef uvishtar. ketzad bishtar. kotev lo al hanneyar o al hacheres hareni machur lecha hareni kanuy lecha venoten lo hashshetar: 
Mecharuhu bet din oved shesh shanim miyyom mechirato uvitchillat hashshana hashsheviit shello yetze ben chorin. veim paga bo shenat hashshemitta bichlal hashshesh hare ze oved bah. aval im paga bo shenat yovel afillu nimkar shana achat lifne hayyovel hare ze yetze lecherut shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach" <small>(Vayikra 25 13)</small> "bishnat hayyovel hazzot" vegomer: 
Hammocher atzmo yesh lo limkor atzmo leyeter al shesh. hare shemmachar atzmo leeser shanim o leesrim shana ufaga bo yovel afillu achar shana hare ze yotze bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach": 
Echad hammocher atzmo o shemmecharuhu bet din uvarach chayyav lehashelim shesh. veim paga bo yovel yotze lecherut: 
Chala ben shechala shana achar shana o shechala cholaim mekuttaim im hakkol pachot mearba shanim olin leminyan shesh. aval im chala arba shanim chayyav lehashelim kol yeme hacholi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 40)</small> "kesachir ketoshav". veim paga bo yovel yetze. bamme devarim amurim shemmechashshevin yeme hacholi keshehaya chalyo kaved sheeno yachol laasot melacha. aval im lo haya chalyo kaved ella yachol laasot maase machat afillu chala kol shesh olin lo: 
Hammocher atzmo leakkum im lo nifda eno yotze ella bayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 54)</small> "veim lo yiggael beelle veyatza bishnat hayyovel hu uvanav immo": 
Hannimkar leakkum im lo hissiga yado ligl kerovav podin oto vekarov karov kodem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 49)</small> "o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu". uvet din kofin et kerovav lifdoto shello yittama baakkum. lo pedauhu kerovav o sheen yadam masseget mitzva al kol adam miyyisrael lifdoto. uven sheppedauhu kerovim ben sheppedaahu shear adam yetze lecherut. veyesh lo lilvot veligl et atzmo min haakkum. vegoel lachatzain. aval hannimkar leyisrael en hakkerovim podin oto veen lo vegoel veeno goel lachatzain. ella ketzad dino. im hissiga yado litten kefi hashshanim hannotarot noten veyotze veim lav lo yetze: 
Echad hammocher atzmo ben leyisrael ben leakkum veechad shemmecharuhu bet din hare ze megarea mippidyono veyotze. ketzad. hare shemmecharuhu beshishshim dinarim veavad arba shanim umatza yado hare ze noten esrim dinarim veyetze lecherut. vechen im machar atzmo bearbaim dinarin leeser shanim hare ze megarea arbaa dinarin lechol shana sheavad venoten hannishar kesef o sheve kesef veyotze. vechen hannimkar leakkum mechashshev haddamim lefi hashshanim hannisharot ad shenat hayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 50)</small> "vechishshav im konehu mishshenat himmachro lo ad shenat hayyovel". ketzad. machar atzmo bemea venishar layyovel mishshenat mechira eser shanim mechashshev asara lechol shana sheavad vegorea haddamim umeshiv hashshear kesef lo tevua velo kelim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 50)</small> "kesef mimkaro" bechesef hu nigal miyyad haakkum veeno nigal bishve kesef: 
Kol eved ivri o ivriyya sheyyatza begiron kesef vehivri vehosifu damav o nishchaf ufachatu damav mechashshevin lo lehakel alav. ketzad. hare shennimkar bemea vahare hu atta shave matayim eno mechashshev im adonav ella lefi mea. nimkar bematayim vahare hu shave mea mechashshev immo al pi hashshanim hannotarot lefi mea: 
Hannimkar leakkum hoil veyesh ligl atzmo lachatzain kemo shebbearnu peamim yihye lehakel ufeamim lehachemir. ketzad lehakel. kana oto bematayim venishchaf vahare hu atta shave mea venatan lo chamishshim chatzi damav vehivri vahare hu shave matayim noten lo mea shehen chatzi damav hannishar veyatza. ketzad lehachemir. kana oto bematayim venatan lo chatzi damav shehen mea venishchaf vahare atta shave mea noten lo chamishshim shehen deme chetzyo hannishar venimtza shennatan mea vachamishshim af al pi shehu atta shave mea: 
Harav shemmachal laeved al hakkesef shennishar lo laavod kenegdo eno machul lo ad sheyyichtov lo shetar shichrur. ketzad. hare shekkanahu beshishshim veavad shana o shenatayim veamar lo shear haddamim mechulin lecha lech ledarkecha lo niftar mishshibudo ad sheyyichtov lo shetar: 
Adon shemmet im hinniach ben zachar hare haeved oved habben ad sof hashshesh o ad sof hashshanim shemmachar atzmo lahen o ad sheyyifga bo yovel o ad sheyyegarea pidyono veyitten hashshear. aval im lo hinniach ben zachar hare ze yetze lecherut veeno oved lo et habbat velo et haach veen tzarich lomar sheeno oved shear hayyorshin. vehannimkar leger tzedek o leakkum afillu habben eno oved ella kevan shemmet haadon yetze lecherut. nimtzeta omer sheeved ivri nikne bechesef o bishtar vekone et atzmo bachamishsha devarim. beshanim o beyovel o begiron kesef o bishtar shichrur o bemitat adon belo ben uveakkum o beger afillu hinniach ben. mitzva lomar lo tze bishat yetziato. af al pi shello amar lo hare hu yotze bechinnam. veeno tzarich shetar. afillu chala vehotzi rabbo alav hotzaot harebe eno chayyav lo kelum shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 2)</small> "yetze lachafshi chinnam":
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 3:
Kol eved ivri hare haadon chayyav bimzonot ishto hannesua lo velo arusa veshomeret yavam. vehu shettihye mutteret lo. aval im hayta meissure lavin afillu sheniyya eno chayyav bimzonoteha shenneemar ishto immo ishsha haruya laamod immo. vechen chayyav bimzonot banav uvenotav. bimcharuhu bet din neemar <small>(Shemot 21 3)</small> "im baal ishsha hu veyatza ishto immo". vechi taale al datecha shekkevan shennikna ze nishtabeda ishto. aval lo ba lelammed ella shehaadon chayyav bimzonoteha. uvemocher atzmo neemar <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veyatza meimmach hu uvanav immo". uvenimkar leakkum neemar <small>(Vayikra 25 54)</small> "veyatza bishnat hayyovel hu uvanav immo". echad ishsha uvanim shehayu lo bishat mechira o ishsha uvanim shehayu lo achar mechirato. vehu sheyyikkachenna middaat haadon. aval im lekachah shello middaat rabbo eno chayyav bimzonoteha: 
Af al pi shehaadon chayyav bimzonot ishto uvanav en lo bemaase yedehem kelum ella hare maase haishsha umetziatah levaalah. vechol shezzoche habbaal beishto zoche ze af al pi shehu eved ivri: 
Mi shemmecharuhu bet din yesh lerabbo litten lo shifcha kenaanit. ben haadon ben beno shel adon im met aviv hare ze noten lo shifcha. vechofehu al ze kede sheyyolid mimmenna avadim. vahare hi mutteret lo kol yeme avduto shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 4)</small> "im adonav yitten lo ishsha" vegomer. vehammocher atzmo asur beshifcha kenaanit kishar kol yisrael: 
En eved ivri muttar beshifcha kenaanit ad shettihye lo ishsha yisreelit uvanim. aval im en lo ishsha uvanim en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit. vedavar ze kabbala hu afillu haya hannimkar kohen hare ze muttar beshifcha kenaanit kol yeme avduto: 
Im hayu lo ishsha uvanim af al pi shemmoser lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit eno yachol lehaferisho meishto uvanav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 3)</small> "ishto immo". veeno yachol litten lo shete shefachot. velo litten shifcha achat lishne avadav haivrim kederech shennoten lakkenaaniyyim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 4)</small> "yitten lo ishsha". nirtza shemmasar lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit vehiggia yovel vehaya rabbo mesarev bo latzet veeno rotze latzet vechaval bo patur shehare neesar beshifcha: 
Hammocher atzmo eno nirtza. aval mecharuhu bet din veavad shesh velo ratza latzet hare ze nirtza veoved ad shenat hayyovel o ad sheyyamut haadon: 
Af al pi shehinniach ben en hannirtza oved et habben mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "vaavado", lo velo livno. <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "leolam", leolamo shel yovel. nimtzeta lamed shehannirtza eno kone et atzmo ella bayyovel uvemitat haadon: 
Eved ivri kohen eno nirtza mippene shennaasa baal mum vahare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 25 41)</small> "veshav el mishpachto" lachazaka shehaya bah. veeno shav lasserara shehaya bah: 
Ketzad rotzin. mevio levet din shel shelosha veomer devarav lifnehem umaggisho lesof shesh el haddelet o el hammezuza keshehen omdin bevinyan. ben delet umezuza shel adon ben shel kol adam. venokev et azno hayemanit begufah shel ozen bemartzea shel mattechet ad sheyyaggia laddelet shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 17)</small> "venatatta veazno uvaddelet". velo neemar <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "mezuza" ella sheyyihye omed ben etzel delet ben etzel mezuza. uma mezuza keshehi omedet af delet keshehi omedet. aval hartzia baddelet af al pi sheen sham mezuza. haadon hu sherotzea beatzmo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 6)</small> "veratza adonav" lo beno velo shelucho velo sheliach bet din. veen rotzin shene avadim keechad sheen osin mitzvot chavilot chavilot: 
<small>(Shemot 21 5)</small> "veim amor yomar haeved" ad sheyyomar veyishne. haeved ad sheyyomar keshehu eved aval im amar achar shesh eno nirtza ad sheyyomar veyishne besof shesh bitchillat peruta acharona. ketzad. kegon shennishar min hayyom sheve peruta middeme mechirato o yeter meat. aval im nishar pachot mishsheve peruta hare ze keomer achar shesh: 
Hayta laeved shifcha kenaanit velo mimmenna banim ulerabbo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 16)</small> "ki ahevcha veet betecha". lerabbo ishsha uvanim velo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 5)</small> "ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay". hu ohev et rabbo verabbo eno ohavo eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach. rabbo ohavo vehu eno ohev et rabbo eno nirtza shenneemar ki ahevcha. hu chole verabbo eno chole eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach. rabbo chole vehu eno chole o shehayu shenehem cholim eno nirtza shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 16)</small> "ki tov lo immach" ad sheyyihyu shenehem betova: 
Ma ben mocher atzmo limcharuhu bet din. mocher atzmo eno nirtza umecharuhu bet din nirtza. mocher atzmo asur beshifcha kenaanit umecharuhu bet din rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit. mocher atzmo nimkar leakkum umecharuhu bet din eno nimkar ella leyisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 12)</small> "ki yimmacher lecha achicha" en bet din mochrin oto ella lecha. mocher atzmo nimkar leshesh veyeter al shesh mecharuhu bet din eno nimkar ella leshesh. mocher atzmo en maanikin lo mecharuhu bet din maanikin lo: 
Mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen haishsha nirtzaat vechen yerae meinyan hakkatuv shehare omer benirtza <small>(Shemot 21 5)</small> "ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay". umahu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 17)</small> "veaf laamatcha taase ken". lehaanik. shekkeshem shemmitzvat ase lehaanik eved ivri kach maanik ama haivriyya: 
Kol hameshalleach avdo vaamato rekam over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 13)</small> "lo teshallechennu rekam" vahare hakkatuv nitteko laase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 14)</small> "haanek taanik lo". echad hayyotze besof shesh o sheyyatza beyovel o bemitat haadon vechen haama haivriyya sheyyatzat beechad mikkol ellu o besimanin hare ellu maanikin lahem. aval hayyotze begiron kesef en maanikin lahem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 13)</small> "vechi teshallechennu chafshi meimmach" veze lo shillecho chafshi ella haeved natan shear haddamim shennishar lo laavod bahen veachar kach yatza. <small>(Devarim 15 14)</small> "haanek taanik lo mitztzoncha miggarnecha umiyyikvecha" beinyan tzon goren veyekev devarim sheyyesh bahem beracha mechamat atzman hu shechayyav lehaanik lo mehem aval hakkesafim vehabbegadim eno chayyav litten lo mehem. vechamma noten lo en pachot mishsheve sheloshim sela ben mimmin echad ben mimminin harebe kishloshim shel kenas haeved shenneemar bo <small>(Shemot 21 32)</small> "yitten ladonav". ben shennitbarech habbayit biglalo ben shello nitbarech shenneemar haanek taanik lo mikkol makom. im ken lamma neemar <small>(Devarim 15 14)</small> "asher berachcha" hakkol lefi habberacha ten lo: 
Im barach ufaga bo yovel keshehu boreach veyatza lecherut eno chayyav lehaaniko shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 13)</small> "vechi teshallechennu" vegomer. enek eved ivri leatzmo veen baal chov gove hemennu. veenek ama haivriyya vechen metziatah leaviha. veim met aviha kodem sheyyavo leyado hare hen shel atzmah veen leacheha bahem kelum sheen adam morish zechut sheyyesh lo bevitto livno:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 4: Ama haivriyya hi hakketanna shemmecharah aviha. umishshettavi shete searot achar shetem esre shana vetease naara eno yachol lemachrah af al pi sheadayin yesh lo reshut bah. veyesh lo lekaddeshah lechol mi sheyyirtze. af hakketanna shehi aylonit besimaneha veenah reuya lahavaat shete searot yesh leaviha lemachrah kol zeman shehi ketanna. aval hattumtum vehaanderoginus eno nimkar lo keeved ivri velo kedin haama haivriyya:

En haav rashshay limkor et bitto ella im ken heeni velo nishar lo kelum lo karka velo mittaltelin vaafillu kesut shealav. veaf al pi chen kofin et haav lifdotah achar shemmecharah mishshum pegam mishpacha. barach haav o shemmet o shello haya lo lifdotah hare zo ovedet ad shettetze:

Ama haivriyya niknet bechesef o bishve kesef uvishtar veenah niknet bifruta mippene shetztzarich liknotah bedamim sheruyin legeraon kede shettigra pidyonah vetetze. ketzad bishtar. kotev al hanneyar o al hacheres bitti mechura lecha bitti kenuya lecha venoten beyad haadon. ushetar ama haivriyya haav kotvo:

Ama haivriyya ovedet shesh shanim keeved shemmecharuhu bet din shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 12)</small> "ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri o haivriyya". veyotzet bitchillat sheva. veim paga bah yovel betoch shesh yotza chinnam keeved. met haadon af al pi shehinniach ben yotza chinnam kenirtza shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 17)</small> "veaf laamatcha taase ken". vechen megaraat mippidyonah veyotza. veim katav lah shetar shichrur umachal al hashshear yotza chinnam keeved:

Yetera ama haivriyya shehi yotza besimanin. ketzad. kegon shehevia simanin venaaset naara yotza lecherut belo kesef afillu hevia simanin meachar yom shellekachah hare zo yotzet lecherut shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 11)</small> "veyatza chinnam" ribba lah hakkatuv yetzia acheret bechinnam yeter al haeved. mippi hashshemua lamdu shehi havaat simane naarut. vetachzor lirshut aviha ad shettivgor vetetze mershut aviha. hayta habbat aylonit sheen lah yeme naarut ella yotzet mikkatnutah leveger kevan shebbagra tetze lecherut:

En ama haivriyya yotza berashe evarim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 7)</small> "lo tetze ketzet haavadim". vechen eved ivri im hippil lo shinno o simme lo eno meshallem lo kedin hachovel bachavero kemo shebbearnu behilchot chovel. nimtzeta lamed sheama haivriyya niknet bishne devarim bechesef o bishtar. vekona atzmah beshishsha devarim beshanim uveyovel uvegiron kesef uvishtar shichrur uvemitat haadon uvesimanin:

Yied otah haadon leatzmo o livno hare hi kishar arusot veenah yotza beechad mikkol ellu ella bemitat habbaal o beget. umitzvat yiud kodemet lemitzvat pediyya. ketzad mitzvat yiud. omer lah bifne shenayim hare at mekuddeshet li hare at meoreset li hare at li leishsha afillu besof shesh samuch lishkiat hachamma. veeno tzarich litten lah kelum shemmaot harishonot lekiddushin nittenu venoheg bah minhag ishut veeno noheg bah minhag shefachot. veeno meyaed shetayim keachat shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 8)</small> "yeadah". vechetzad meyaadah livno. im haya beno gadol venatan reshut leaviv leyaadah lo hare haav omer lah bifne shenayim hare at mekuddeshet livni:

En haadon meyaed ama haivriyya lo lo velo livno ella middatah af al pi shekkevar kibbel aviha meoteha shehare hu omer <small>(Shemot 21 8)</small> "yeadah" middatah. veim met haadon en beno yuchal leyaadah lo shehare yotza lecherut bemitat haadon:

Hayyiud keerusin veeno kenissuin lefichach eno mittamme lah velo yirashenna velo mefer nedareha ad shettikkanes lechuppa. <small>(Shemot 21 11)</small> "veim shelash elle lo yaase lah", lo yiadah lo velo yiadah livno velo nifdet begiron kesef, veyatza chinnam bahavaat simanin kemo shebbearnu:

Yeter al otan hadderachim shekkona bahen atzmah keeved ivri. en haadon yachol limkor ama haivriyya velo littenah leish acher ben rachok ben karov veim machar o natan lo asa kelum shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 8)</small> "leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah bevigdo vah". vechen eved ivri lo yachol lemachro leacher velo litteno. veyerae li shello hutzrach hakkatuv leesor davar ze [beama] ella mippene sheyyesh lo leyaadah livno lechach neemar leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah:

En ama haivriyya nimkeret ella lemi sheyyesh lah alav o livno kiddushin kede shettehe reuya leyiud. ketzad. mocher adam et bitto leaviv sheaf al pi sheen haadon yachol leyaadah lo reuya hi livno shehare haama bat achiv. aval eno yachol limkor et bitto livno mippene sheenah reuya leadon shehare hi achoto velo livno mippene shehi achot aviv:
Yesh leadam limkor bitto lifsulin kegon almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot sheaf al pi shehen belav kiddushin tofsin bahen:

Hamekaddesh et bitto keshehi ketanna venitarmela o nitgarsha eno yachol lemachrah sheen adam yachol limkor et bitto leshifchut achar ishut. aval mochrah leshifcha achar shifchut. ketzad. mecharah leshifchut techilla veyied otah haadon umet haadon o gershah vechazra lirshut haav keshehi ketanna hare haav mochrah paam sheniyya afillu lechohen. vechen im nafla lifne yavam min hayyiud vechalatz lah af al pi shehi chalitza pesula mippene shehi ketanna hare nifsela min hakkehunna veyesh lo lemachrah lechohen hoil vekiddushin tofsin bah kemo shennitbaer:
Hammocher et bitto veyatza beshanim o beyovel o begiron kesef vaadayin hi ketanna yesh lo lachzor ulemachrah paam sheniyya kemo shebbearnu:
Hammocher et bitto veachar kach halach vekiddeshah leacher im ratza haadon leyaed meyaed veim lo yied haadon lo lo velo livno keshettetze mershut haadon yiggamru kiddusheha vetease eshet ish:
Hammocher et bitto ufasak al haadon al menat shello leyaed otah im ratza haadon leyaed meyaed shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora shettenao batel:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 5: Eved kenaani nikne bachamishsha devarim vekone et atzmo bishlosha. nikne bechesef o bishtar o bachazaka o bachalifin o bimshicha. vekone et atzmo bechesef o bishtar o berashe evarim. veeved katan hare hu kivhema venikne bimshicha kimshichat habbehema. uchevar bearnu bitchillat sefer ze kol hadderachim shehaavadim niknin bahen:

Ketzad kone et atzmo bechesef. kegon shennatan echad lerabbo maot veamar lo al menat sheyyetze avdecha bahem lecherut kevan shekkibbel harav et hakkesef o sheve kesef yatza haeved lecherut. veen tzarich daat haeved shezzechut hi lo vezachin leadam shello befanav. vechen im natan echad leeved maot veamar al menat shettetze bahem lecherut im ratza haadon lekabbel hammaot yatza haeved lecherut veim lo ratza lo kana haeved hammaot shello natan lo ella al menat sheyyetze bahem lecherut. veechad hakkesef o sheve kesef ben liknoto ben lehakenot atzmo lo:

Ketzad bishtar. kotev lo al hanneyar o al hacheres hare at ben chorin o hare at shel atzmecha o en li esek becha. vechen kol kayyotze baze beinyan ze shezze hu gufo shel get shichrur. umoser lo et hashshetar bifne shene edim o shehayu haedim chatumim bo umesaro lo beno leveno. hare ze yatza lecherut shehare gitto veyado bain keechad. amar lo shello bichtav hare at ben chorin hare at shel atzmecha af al pi sheheidu alav edim bevet din veaf al pi shekkanu miyyado adayin lo nishtachrer sheen haeved yotze lecherut ella bechesef o bishtar o berashe evarim. vhakkotev leshifchato hare at mutteret lechol adam lo amar kelum:

Ketzad berashe evarim. hammakke et avdo bechavvana vchisro echad meesrim vearbaa rashe evarim sheenan chozrin yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur. im ken lamma neemar battora <small>(Shemot 21 27)</small> "shen" v <small>(Shemot 21 26)</small> "ayin" liddon mehen ma shen veayin mumin shebbegaluy veenan chozrin af kol mumin shebbegaluy veenan chozrin yetze haeved bo lecherut. aval hamesares avdo babbetzim o hachotech leshono eno yotze lecherut sheenan mumin shebbegaluy. vechen hammappil shen hakkatan eno yotze lecherut shehare sofo lachzor:

En yotze berashe evarim ella avadim shemmalu vetavlu shehare yeshnan bemiktzat mitzvot aval haeved shehu begeuto eno yotze berashe evarim. ellu hen rashe evarim sheenan chozrin. etzbeot yadayim veraglayim esrim rashe haaznayim verosh hachotem verosh haggeviyya verashe haddadin shebbaishsha aval haenayim vehashshinnayim hare hen meforashin battora:

Hayta lo etzba yetera vachatachah im nisperet al gav hayyad eved yotze bah lecherut. hayta eno semuya vechittah eved yotze bah lecherut shehare chissero evar. vehu haddin leechad merashe evarim shehu batel veeno ose bo melacha sheim chatacho hare chissero evar veyatza lecherut:
Hikkahu al eno vesimmeah al azno vechershah eved yotze bahen lecherut. hikkahu keneged eno veeno roe keneged azno veeno shomea en eved yotze bahen lecherut:
Hikkahu al eno vechasra meorah. al shinno veniddedah. im yachol lehishtammesh bahem eno yotze lecherut veim lav yetze lecherut:
Hayta eno keha vechisser meorah o shinno nodedet vehikkahu haadon vehippil hashshen hannodedet o simme haayin hakkeha im haya mishtammesh bahen kol shehu yetze lecherut veim lav lo yetze lecherut:
Hikkahu al yado vetzavta yado vesofah lachzor eno yotze lecherut. talash bizkano vedildel bo etzem min hallechi yetze lecherut shehare bittel maase hashshinnayim hakkevuot beoto haetzem:

Hippil et shinno o simme et eno belo kavvana kegon shezzarak even livhema venafla baeved vehippila et shinno vechatcha etzbao lo yetze lecherut shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 27)</small> "im shen avdo o shen amato yappil" ad sheyyitkavven:
Hoshit yado lime shifchato vesimme en haubbar shebbemeeha lo yetze lecherut shehare lo yada davar sheyyitkavven lo:

Hare shehaya rabbo rofe veamar lo kechol li eni vesimmeah chator li shinni vehippilah sachak baadon veyetze lecherut sheaf al pi shello nitkavven lehazzik hare nitkavven lingoa beevre haeved venistakken bahen. veen tzarich lomar im hayta en haeved koevet vehaya rabbo umman vaakarah lo shehare yetze lecherut:
Hammappil shen avdo vesimme et eno hare yetze lecherut beshinno venoten lo deme eno. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin veeved shel shene shuttafin eno yotze berashe evarim lefi sheeno meyuchad lerabbo shechaval bo:

Avde tzon barzel yotzin berashe evarim im chisseran habbaal aval lo haishsha. veavde melog enan yotzin berashe evarim lo im hippil habbaal shehare en lo bahem ella perot velo im hippila otan haishsha mippene sheenan meyuchadin lah:

Yetziat haeved berashe evarim noheg bechol makom uvechol zeman veen danin bo ella bevet din semuchin mippene shehu kenas. lefichach haeved sheamar lerabbo hippalta et shinni vesimmeta et eni vehaadon omer lo asiti ze patur sheim yode meatzmo eno chayyav lehotzio lecherut belo edim shehammode biknas patur kemo shebbearnu behilchot geneva shekkol mode biknas patur milleshallemo:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 6: Hakkotev get shichrur leavdo vezikka lo bo al yede acher veamar zeche beget ze lifloni avdi yatza lecherut af al pi shello higgia get leyado shezzachin leadam shello befanav. aval im amar tenu get ze leavdi eno yachol lachzor bo velo yetze haeved lecherut ad sheyyaggia hagget leyado. lefichach haomer tenu get ze leavdi umet lo yittenu leachar mita:
Hakkotev bishtar asiti peloni avdi ben chorin o naasa peloni avdi ben chorin o hare hu ben chorin hare ze yetze lecherut. katav bashshetar eesennu ben chorin lo yetze lecherut:

Haomer asiti peloni avdi ben chorin vehu omer lo asaani choshshin shemma zikka lo al yede acher. amar katavti get shichrur venatatti lo vehu amar lo katav velo natan hodaat baal din kemea edim vahare ze eved ad sheyyeshachrerenu befanenu:

Mi shetztzivva bishat mitato pelonit shifchati al yishtabedu bah yorshay hare zo shifcha keshehayta veasur layyorshim lehishtabed bah mippene shemmitzva lekayyem divre hammet. vechen im amar asu lah korat ruach kofin et hayyorshin veen mishtabedin bah ella bimlacha shehi rotza bah. tzivva veamar shachreruha kofin et hayyorshin leshachrer otah:

Beshishsha devarim shavin shichrure avadim legitte nashim uvishar devarim hare hen kishar kol hashshetarot. veellu hen hashshishsha. pesulim bearkaot shel akkum. uchesherin beed kuti. utzerichin ketiva leshem hammeshuchrar atzmo. veen nichtavin bimchubbar. veen chotmin edehem ella ze bifne ze. echad gitte nashim veechad shichrure avadim shavin lammolich velammevi. ketzad. kol hashshetarot haolim bearkaot shel akkum kesherim bechol hattenaim sheanu mevaarim behilchot halevaa chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim:

Kol shetar sheyyesh alav afillu ed echad kuti pasul chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim shehen kesherin beed echad yisrael veed echad kuti vehu sheyyihye kuti chaver. uvazzeman hazze shehakkutim keakkum lechol divrehem anu lemedin mehen litzdokin shehatztzedokin bazzeman hazze kemo kuti beoto hazzeman kodem sheggazru alehem sheyyihyu keakkum lechol divrehem. beget ishsha hu omer <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vechatav lah" lishmah uveget shichrur hu omer <small>(Vayikra 19 20)</small> "o chufsha lo nittan lah", ad sheyyichtov lishmah. beget ishsha hu omer vechatav venatan mi sheeno mechussar ella netina yatza hakkotev bimchubbar veachar kach kitztzetz shehare mechussar ketzitza unetina uveget shichrur hu omer (venatan lah) lo yihye mechussar ella netina. echad gitte nashim veshichrure avadim enan chotmin edehem ella ze bifne ze. uchevar bearnu taam haddavar behilchot gerushin:

Vechetzad shavin bemolich umevi shehammevi get shichrur beeretz yisrael en tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam uvechutza laaretz im en edim metzuyin lekayyemo veamar hashshaliach befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam zehu kiyyumo. veim ba haadon veirer achar kach en mashgichin bo kemo shebbearnu begitte nashim. keshem shehaishsha atzmah mevia gittah veenah tzericha lekayyemo hoil vehagget yotze mittachat yadah kach haeved sheshshetar shichrur yotze mittachat yado eno tzarich lekayyemo. ucheshem shehaishsha omeret befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam im hitna aleha kemo shebbearnu bimkomo kach haeved shehevi get veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam neeman al oto hadderech veen tzarich kiyyum:

Kol hakkasher lehavi get haishsha kasher lehavi get haeved. vehaeved mekabbel get lachavero miyyad rabbo shel chavero aval lo miyyad rabbo shel mekabbel. hakkotev shetar erusin leshifchato af al pi sheamar lah tzei bo lecherut vehitkaddeshi bo en ballashon hazze leshon shichrur veenah mekuddeshet velo meshuchreret:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 7:
Get shichrur tzarich sheyyihye inyano davar hakkoret beno leven adonav velo yishshaer laadon bo zechut. lefichach hakkotev leavdo atzmecha vechol nechasay kenuyin lecha chutz mimmakom peloni o chutz mittallit pelonit en ze koret vehagget batel umittoch sheeno get en haeved meshuchrar velo kana min hannechasim kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Eved shehevi get vechatuv bo atzmecha unechasay kenuyin lecha atzmo kana vahare hu ben chorin aval hannechasim lo kana ad sheyyitkayyem hagget bechotmav kishar hashshetarot. vechen im haya katuv bo kol nechasay kenuyin lecha kana atzmo velo kana hannechasim ad sheyyitkayyem hagget bechotmav shecholkim haddibbur veomrim atzmo kana mippene shehu neeman lehavi get shichruro veeno tzarich lekayyemo aval hannechasim sheen adam kone otam ella biraya berura lo yikne otam ad sheyyitkayyem hashshetar: 
Hameshachrer shene avadim bishtar echad lo kanu atzman ella kotvin shetar lechol echad veechad. lefichach hakkotev kol nechasav lishne avadav bishtar echad af atzman lo kanu. veim katav bishne shetarot kanu umeshachrerin ze et ze. bamme devarim amurim beshekkatav bechol shetar mishshenehem kol nechasay netunim lifloni ufeloni avdi. aval im katav chatzi nechasay lifloni avdi vachatzi nechasay lifloni avdi af bishne shetarot lo kanu kelum shehaeved mikkelal nechasim vahare shiyyer bo chetzyo veen ze shichrur vechevan shello nishtachrer lo kana min hannechasim kelum: 
Hameshachrer chatzi avdo bishtar lo kana haeved chetzyo vahare hu eved keshehaya. aval im shichrer chetzyo bechesef kegon shellakach chatzi damav al menat leshachrer chetzyo kana venimtza chetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. bamme devarim amurim besheshshichrer chetzyo bishtar vehinniach chetzyo. aval im shichrer chetzyo umachar chetzyo o sheshshichrer chetzyo venatan chetzyo bemattana hoil veyatza haeved kullo mershuto kana haeved chetzyo vahare ze chetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. vechen eved shel shene shuttafin veshichrer echad mehen chelko ben bechesef ben bishtar kana haeved chetzyo vahare hu chetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin: 
Hakkotev leshifchato meubberet hare at bat chorin uveladech eved devarav kayyamin. hare at shifcha uveladech ben chorin lo amar velo kelum shezze kemi shemmeshachrer chetzyah: 
Shifcha charufa im ratza leshachrer chetzyah hannishar vetease eshet ish gemura hare ze meshachrer ben bechesef ben bishtar sheaf hakkesef gomer shichrurah: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin hoil veeno muttar lo beshifcha velo bevat chorin kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar alav bachatzi damav. bamme devarim amurim beeved mippene shehaish metzuvve al periyya ureviyya. aval hashshifcha tishshaer kemot shehi veovedet et rabba yom echad veet atzmah yom echad. veim nahagu bah hachotim minhag hefker kofin et rabba leshachrer vechotev aleha shetar bachatzi dameha: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin sheamad rabbo vehikna chetzyo livno hakkatan kede shello yachofu oto bet din leshachrero maamidin bet din lakkatan appotroppos vechotev lo haappotroppos get shichrur vechotev lo shetar chov bachatzi damav. veim nitztarech hakkatan beeved veyesh lo gaguin alav mafligin oto mimmennu bemaot sheddato shel katan karov etzel maot: 
Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leavdo veamad chozer bannechasim veeno chozer baeved shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 8:
Hammocher et avdo leakkum yetze ben chorin vechofin et rabbo lachzor veliknoto min haakkum ad asara bedamav vechotev lo get shichrur veyotze. veim lo ratza haakkum lemachro afillu baasara bedamav en mechayyevin oto yeter. ukenas ze en govin oto vedanin oto ella bevet din mumchin. veim met hammocher en konsin et hayyoresh lehachezir et haeved leshichrur: 
Lava al avdo min haakkum im kava lo zeman veamar lo im higgia zeman peloni velo ashallem lecha tikne guf eved ze hare ze yetze lecherut miyyad. veim amar lo tikne maase yadav lo yetze lecherut. gevao akkum bechovo o shebbau al haadon metzerim uvikkeshu lehargo ufada atzmo miyyadan beavdo lo yatza lecherut mippene shennilkach mimmennu shello birtzono: 
Machar avdo leechad meavde hammelech o miggedolav af al pi shehu mityare mehem yatza haeved lecherut mippene shehaya yachol lefayyeso bemamon acher: 
Mecharo leakkum lishloshim yom. mecharo chutz mimmelachto. chutz min hammitzvot. chutz mishshabbatot veyamim tovim. hare ze safek im nishtachrer o lo nishtachrer. lefichach im tafas haeved kede damav lerabbo kede sheyyetze bahen lecherut miyyad akkum en motziin miyyado: 
Echad mocher avdo leakkum oved avoda zara o shemmecharo leger toshav afillu lechuti hare ze yetze lecherut. mecharo leyisrael mumar hare ze safek lefichach im tafas kede damav merabbo rishon kede latzet bahen miyyad hammumar en motziin miyyado: 
Hammocher avdo lechutza laaretz yatza ben chorin vechofin et rabbo hashsheni lichtov lo get shichrur veavdu haddamim. umippene ma kansu kan hallokeach levaddo sheillu lo lakach ze lo yatza haeved lechutza laaretz. hammocher avdo lesureya vaafillu leakko kemocher lechutza laaretz: 
Ben bavel shennasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vedato lachzor vehichnisa lo ishto avadim ushefachot hare ellu safek im hem kemi shemmachra otam lechutza laaretz hoil veyesh lo happerot o enan kimchurin lo shehare hagguf shellah: 
Eved sheyyatza achar rabbo lesureya umecharo sham ibbed et zechuto. bamme devarim amurim kesheyyatza rabbo al menat shello lachzor leeretz yisrael. aval im daat rabbo lachzor veyatza acharav umecharo sham yatza lecherut vechofin et hallokeach leshachrero: 
Eved sheamar laalot leeretz yisrael kofin et rabbo laalot immo o yimkor oto lemi sheyyaaluhu lesham. ratza haadon latzet lechutza laaretz eno yachol lehotzi et avdo ad sheyyirtze. vedin ze bechol zeman afillu bazzeman hazze shehaaretz beyad akkum: 
Eved shebbarach michutza laaretz laaretz en machazirin lo leavdut vealav neemar <small>(Devarim 23 16)</small> "lo tasgir eved el adonav". veomer lerabbo sheyyichtov lo get shichrur veyichtov lo shetar chov bedamav ad shettassig yado veyitten lo. veim lo ratza haadon leshachrero mafkiin bet din shibudo mealav veyelech lo: 
Eved ze shebbarach laaretz hare hu ger tzedek vehosif lo hakkatuv azhara acheret lemi shemmeanne oto mippene shehu shefal ruach yoter min hagger vetzivva alav hakkatuv shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 17)</small> "immecha yeshev bekirbecha" <small>(Devarim 23 17)</small> "beachad shearecha" <small>(Devarim 23 17)</small> "battov lo lo tonennu". zo af honayat devarim. nimtzeta lamed shehameanne et hagger hazze over bishlosha lavin mishshum <small>(Vayikra 25 17)</small> "velo tonu ish et amito" umishshum <small>(Shemot 22 20)</small> "veger lo tone" umishshum lo tonennu. vechen over mishshum <small>(Shemot 22 20)</small> "velo tilchatzennu" kemo shebbearnu beinyan honaya:
