Hakkone eved min haakkum setam velo ratza lamul ulekabbel mitzvot haavadim megalgelin immo kol shenem asar chodesh veim lo ratza chozer umochro leakkum o lechutza laaretz. veim hitna haeved alav techilla shello yamul hare ze muttar lekayyemo kol zeman sheyyirtze begeuto umochro leakkum o lechutza laaretz. vechen eved shemmal vetaval leshem avdut veachar kach hippil atzmo ligyasot veen rabbo yachol lehotzio lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam hare ze muttar lo littol damav min haakkum vechotev umaale bearkaot shel akkum mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam: 
Hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur. veim met haadon shehifkiro hayyoresh kotev lo get shichrur: 
Eved shebbarach mibbet haasurin im nityaesh mimmennu rabbo yatza lecherut vechofin et rabbo vechotev lo get shichrur: 
Eved shennishba im nityaesh mimmennu rabbo rishon kol happode oto leshem eved yishtabed bo vahare hu shello. veim padahu leshem ben chorin hare ze ben chorin. veim lo nityaesh mimmennu rabbo rishon happode oto leshem eved notel pidyono merabbo vechozer lerabbo. veim padahu leshem ben chorin chozer lerabbo harishon belo kelum: 
Eved sheasao rabbo appoteke levaal chovo veshichrero hare ze meshuchrar vechofin et baal chovo leshachrero. gam ze mippene tikkun haolam shello yifga bo leachar zeman veyomar lo avdi atta: 
Eved shehissio rabbo bat chorin o shehinniach lo rabbo tefillin berosho o sheamar lo rabbo likrot shelosha pesukin besefer tora bifne tzibbur. vechen kol kayyotze beellu haddevarim sheeno chayyav bahen ella ben chorin yetze lecherut vechofin et rabbo lichtov lo get shichrur. vechen im nadar neder shekkofin alav et haavadim kemo shebbearnu bindarim veamar lo rabbo mufar lecha yetze lecherut shekkevan shello kafa oto bemakom sheyyesh lo lichpoto gilla dato shehifkia shibudo. mikkan ani omer shehameshachrer avdo bechol lashon vehotzi devarim mippiv shemmashmaan shello nishar lo alav shibud kelal vesheggamar belibbo ledavar ze sheeno yachol lachzor bo kofin oto lichtov lo get shichrur af al pi sheadayin lo katav. aval im lava meavdo o sheasahu appotroppos o shehinniach tefillin bifne rabbo o shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset bifne rabbo velo micha bo lo yetze lecherut: 
Veasur leadam lelammed et avdo tora veim limmedo lo yatza lecherut: 
Hallokeach eved min haakkum vekadam haeved vetaval bifne rabbo leshem ben chorin yatza lecherut. shello bifne rabbo tzarich lefaresh lefichach tzarich rabbo letakpo bammayim: 
Yisrael shettakaf akkum katan o matza tinok akkum vehitbilo leshem ger hare ze ger. leshem eved hare ze eved. leshem ben chorin hare ze ben chorin: 
Ger shekkadmu avadav veshifchotav vetavlu lefanav kanu atzman bene chorin:
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 9:
Yisrael shebba al shifcha kenaanit af al pi shehi shifchato hare ze havvalad kenaani lechol davar venimkar venikne umishtammeshim bo leolam kishar haavadim: 
Echad hakkone eved kenaani miyyisrael o min ger toshav o min akkum shehu kavush tachat yadenu o meechad mishshear haummot yesh lo limkor et atzmo leyisrael leeved vahare hu eved kenaani lechol davar. vechen mocher banav uvenotav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 45)</small> "mehem tiknu umimmishpachtam asher immachem asher holidu beartzechem". vechol echad meellu hare hu keeved kenaani lechol davar: 
Echad min haummot shebba al shifcha kenaanit shellanu hare habben eved kenaani shenneemar asher holidu beartzechem. aval haeved shellanu shebba al achat min haummot en habben eved shenneemar asher holidu beartzechem veeved en lo yachas: 
Melech akkum sheasa milchama vehevi shivya umecharah. vechen im hirsha lechol mi sheyyirtze sheyyelech veyignov meumma shehi osa immo milchama sheyyavi veyimkor leatzmo. vechen im hayu dinav shekkol mi shello yitten hammas yimkor. o mi sheasa kach vechach o lo yaase yimkor. hare dinav din veeved hannilkach bedinin ellu hare hu keeved kenaani lechol davar: 
Akkum shekkana akkum leavdut lo kana gufo veen lo bo ella maase yadav. af al pi chen im mecharo leyisrael hare gufo kanuy leyisrael: 
Haishsha kona shefachot veenah kona avadim afillu ketannim mippene hachashad veim kanta otam hare zo kanta gufam keish. veyerae li sheenah asura liknot ella eved ben tesha shanim umittesha ulemala. vechen asur leadam leshachrer eved kenaani. vechol hameshachrero over baase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 46)</small> "lelam bahem taavodu". veim shichrero meshuchrar kemo shebbearnu. vechofin oto lichtov get shichrur bechol hadderachim shebbearnu. umuttar leshachrero lidvar mitzva afillu lemitzva shel divrehem kegon shello hayu asara bevet hakkeneset hare ze meshachrer avdo umashlim bo hamminyan. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen shifcha shennohagin bah haam minhag hefker vahare hi michshol lachotim kofin et rabba umeshachrerah kede shettinnase veyasur hammichshol. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Yachol harav lomar leavdo kenaani asa immi veeni zancha ella yelech veyishal al happetachim veyitparnes min hatztzedaka sheyyisrael metzuvvin lehachayot haavadim shebbenehem. bamme devarim amurim baavadav sheen bet din nizkakin ligdolim lishmor mamonam veim lo yaachil laavadav veyashkem karauy hem yivrechu o yamutu veadam chas al mamon atzmo yeter mikkol adam. aval avadim shehichnisa lo ishto betorat nichse melog chayyav bimzonotehen sheal menat ken hichnis otam sheim lo yazun otam yamutu veyivrechu vahare eno chayyav beacharayutan: 
Muttar laavod beeved kenaani befarech. veaf al pi shehaddin kach middat chasidut vedarche chachma sheyyihye adam rachman verodef tzedek velo yachbid ello al avdo velo yatzer lo veyaachilehu veyashkehu mikkol maachol umikkol mishte. chachamim harishonim hayu notnin laeved mikkol tavshil vetavshil shehayu ochlin. umakdimin mezon habbehemot vehaavadim lisudat atzman. hare hu omer <small>(Tehillim 123 2)</small> "cheene avadim el yad adonehem keene shifcha el yad gevirtah". vechen lo yevazzehu bayyad velo bidvarim. leavdut mesaran hakkatuv lo levusha. velo yarbe alav tzeaka vechaas ella yedabber immo benachat veyishma taanotav. vechen meforash bedarche iyyov hattovim shehishtabbeach bahen <small>(Iyov lo 13)</small> "im emas mishpat avdi vaamati berivam immadi" <small>(Iyov lo 15)</small> "halo vabbeten oshoni asahu vaychunennu barechem echad". veen haachzariyyut vehaazzut metzuya ella beakkum ovde avoda zara aval zaro shel avraham avinu vehem yisrael shehishpia lahem hakkadosh baruch hu tovat hattora vetzivva otam bechukkim umishpatim tzaddikim rachmanim hem al hakkol. vechen bemiddotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu shetztzivvanu lehiddamot bahem hu omer <small>(Tehillim 145 9)</small> "verachamav al kol maasav". vechol hamerachem merachamin alav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha":
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 1: Kol hammemir loke al kol behema uvehema sheyyamir shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto" veaf al pi shello asa maase. mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkol mitzvat lo taase sheen bah maase en lokin aleha chutz minnishba umemir umekallel et chavero beshem. shelosha lavin ellu i efshar sheyyihye bahen maase kelal velokin alehen. velamma lokin al hattemura vahare lav shebbah nittak laase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "veim hamer yemirennu vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh". mippene sheyyesh bah ase ushene lavin. veod sheen lav shebbah shave laase. shehatztzibbur vehashshuttafin en osin temura im hemiru af al pi shehen muzharin shello yamiru. nimtzeta omer shehayyachid shehemir hare hattemura kodesh. vaafillu hemir beshabbat loke arbaim. veechad min hashshuttafin shehemir. o mi shehemir bekarban mikkarbenot hatztzibbur. hoil veyesh lo bahen shuttafut hare ze loke veen hattemura kodesh:

Echad hammemir bezadon o shehemir bishgaga hare ze ose temura veloke. ketzad. hammitkavvin lomar hare zo temurat ola sheyyesh li veamar hare zo temurat shelamim sheyyesh li. hare zo temura veloke. aval im dimma shemmuttar lehamir vehemir o sheamar ekkanes levayit ze veamir middati venichnas veshachach vehemir shello middato hare zo temura veeno loke aleha:

En adam memir behemto bekarban sheeno shello. veim amar baal hakkarban kol harotze lehamir bivhemti yavo veyamir hare ze memir bah. hemir karbano bivhema sheenah shello enah temura sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello:

Hammitkapper hu sheose temura aval lo hammakdish. ketzad. hikdish behema sheyyitkapper bah chavero kegon shehikdish karbenot nazir sheyyitkapper bahem peloni hannazir. oto hannazir hu sheose bahen temura aval lo ze shehikdish lefi sheenan shello:
Hayyoresh memir. hinniach behema lishne banav umet hare zo kereva veen memirin bah shehare hem bah shuttafin vehashshuttafin en osin temura kemo shebbearnu:
En kadshe nachrim osin temura min hattora aval middivre sofrim shehannachri shehemir hare zo temura. hikdish hannachri behema sheyyitkapper bah yisrael vehemir bah hannachri hare zo sefek temura:
Echad anashim veechad nashim im hemiru osin temura:
Katan shehiggia leonat nedarim shehemir. af al pi sheeno loke yesh bo safek im ose temura o eno ose temura:

En hakkohanim memirin bechattat uveasham sheaf al pi shehem shellahem enan zochin bahen mechayyim sheen lahem babbasar ad sheyyizzarek haddam. veen hakkohanim memirin bivchor sheaf al pi shehu zoche bo mechayyim eno zoche bo mittechilla shehare techillato bevet yisrael hu. aval habbealim shehemiru bivchor kol zeman shehu bevetam osim temura. vechen kohen shehemir bivchor shennolad lo lo bivchor shellakach miyyisrael hare zo temura:
Elo shel kohen gadol ose temura aval paro eno ose temura af al pi shehu mishshello hoil veechav hakkohanim mitkapperin bo hare hem bo keshuttafin:
Haofot vehammenachot enan osin temura shello neemar ella <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "behema":

Karbenot bedek habbayit enan osin temura shenneemar bemaaser <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu" vahalo hammaaser bichlal kol hakkadashim haya velamma yatza lelammed al hakkelal ma maaser karban yachid yatzu karbenot tzibbur vechen hashshuttafin ma maaser karban mizbeach yatzu kadshe bedek habbayit ma maasar behema hukkash lemaasar dagan sheen chayyavin bo ella yisrael velo nachrim yatzu karbenot nachrim sheen osin temura kemo shebbearnu:

Hammakdish baalat mum kavua enah osa temura mippene shello nitkaddesh gufah kiddush gamur veenah ella kedushshat damim. aval hammakdish baalat mum over o shehikdish temima veachar kach nolad lah mum kavua hare zo osa temura:

Echad hammemir tamim bevaal mum o baal mum betamim o shehemir bakar betzon o tzon bevakar. o kevasim beizzim o izzim bichvasim o nekevot bizcharim o zecharim binkevot. o shehemir echad bemea o mea beechad ben bevat achat ben bazo achar zo. hare zo temura veloke keminyan habbehemot shehemir:

En hattemura osa temura velo velad behemot hahekdesh ose temura shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "vehaya hu utemurato" hu velo velado utemurato velo temurat temurato. aval hammemir bivhema vechazar vehemir bah vechazar vehemir afillu elef kullan temura veloke al kol echad veechad kemo shebbearnu:

En memirin evarim o ubbarim bishlemim velo shelemim bahen. ketzad. haomer raglah shel behema zo o yadah tachat ola zo o sheamar ubbar behema zo tachat ola zo enah temura. vechen haomer behema zo tachat yadah o raglah shel ola zo o sheamar behema zo tachat ubbarah shel chattat zo enah temura:

Hammemir bechilayim o bitrefa veyotze dofen o betumtum veanderoginus en hakkedushsha chala alehen vahare ze kemi shehemir begamal o bachamor lefi sheen beminan karban ulefichach eno loke. ma ben ellu levaal mum. baal mum yesh beminan karban. ellu en beminam karban:
Harovea vehannirba hare hem kevaal mum veosin temura. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:
Behema shechetzyah kodesh vechetzyah chol lo osa temura velo naaset temura:
Kol hachattaot sheddinan sheyyamutu enan osin temura vechol chattat sheddinah shettire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher osa temura:

Hammafrish nekeva lefischo o leolato o laashamo osa temura af al pi sheenan reuyin likkarev hoil veyardu likdushshat damim vahare hem temimim yardu likdushshat hagguf. aval hammafrish sair lechattato venasi shehifrish seira lechattato vechohen gadol shehifrish para lechattato. enan osin temura shekkol hameshanne bechattaot lo nitkaddesha kelal vaafillu kedushshat damim kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin:
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 2:
Hatemura hu sheyyomar baal hakkarban al behemat chullin sheyyesh lo hare zo tachat zo. o hare zo chalifat zo. veen tzarich lomar im amar hare zo tachat chattat zo o tachat ola zo shehi temura. vechen im amar hare zo tachat chattat sheyyesh li betoch habbayit o tachat ola sheyyesh li bemakom peloni hare zo temura vehu sheyyesh lo. aval im amar al behemat chullin hare zo tachat ola o hare zo tachat chattat lo amar kelum. vechen im amar hare zo mechullelet al zo enah temura:
Hayu lefanav shete behemot achat chullin veachat hekdesh shennafal bah mum. hinniach yado al behemat chullin veamar hare zo tachat zo hare zo temura veloke. hinniach yado al behemat hekdesh veamar hare zo tachat zo hare ze chillelah al behemat hachullin veen zo temura ella kefode baalat mum bezo habbehema:
Hayu lefanav shalosh behemot kadshe mizbeach veachat mehen baalat mum shehare hi omedet lefidyon veshalosh behemot temimot chullin veamar hare ellu tachat ellu. hare shetayim min hachullin tachat shetayim hattemimot temuratan temura veloke alehem shetayim. vehabbehema hashshelishit hi tachat baalat mum shennitchallela aleha ulechallelah nitkavven velo lehamir bah. shekkevan sheyyesh lefanav derech issur vehi hattemura vederech hetter vehu hachillul chazaka hi sheen adam manniach hahetter veose haissur ulefichach eno loke shalosh malkiyyot. vechen im amar eser behemot ellu tachat eser behemot ellu veachat mehen baalat mum eno loke ella tesha malkiyyot shehabbehema haasirit lechallelah nitkavven velo lehamir bah. sheaf al pi shehuchzak ze bemalkiyyot harebe hoil veyesh sham derech hetter eno manniach devar hahetter veose haissur. shete behemot shel hekdesh veachat mehen baalat mum ushete behemot shel chullin veachat mehen baalat mum veamar hare ellu tachat ellu hare hattemima temurat hattemima veloke achat uvaalat hammum mechullelet al baalat hammum sheeno meniach hahetter veose haissur:
Haomer hare zo temurat ola ushelamim devarav kayyamim vetimmacher veyavi bachatzi dameha temurat ola uvachatzi dameha temurat shelamim. amar hare zo temurat ola utemurat shelamim im nitkavven lechach mittechilla devarav kayyamim veim lo nitkavven battechilla ella litmurat ola vechazar veamar temurat shelamim af al pi shechazar betoch kede dibbur en tofsin ella lashon rishon vahare hi temurat ola bilvad:
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 3:
Ketzad din hattemurot likkarev. temurat haola tikkarev ola veim hayta temuratah nekeva o baalat mum tire hannekeva ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bedameha ola. temurat hachattat tamut kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin. temurat haasham tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava. temurat hashshelamim kishlamim lechol davar teuna semicha unesachim utenufat chaze veshok. temurat hattoda ketoda ella sheenah teuna lechem kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin. temurat happesach im hemir bah kodem chatzot yom arbaa asar en temurato kereva ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyavi bedameha shelamim veim hemir bah achar chatzot hare hattemura atzmah tikkarev shelamim. temurat habbechor vehammaaser enam kerevin leolam shenneemar bivchor <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "laAdonai hu". mippi hashshemua lamdu hu karev veen temurato kereva. vedin hammaaser bivchor temuratan tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veteachel: 
Temurat habbechor lakkohanim utemurat hammaaser labbealim. ucheshem sheen podin bechor umaaser shennafal bahen mum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach kach en podim temuratan:
Behema shehikdishah chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim temuratah kamoha. vechen kol behemat hekdesh sheenah kereva mippene techillat hekdeshah hare temuratah kamoha. amar chatzi behema zo temura vechetzyah ola hare zo tikkarev ola. chetzyah ola vechetzyah maaser tikkarev ola. chetzyah temura vechetzyah maaser hare zo safek veenah kereva:
Hammakdish baalat mum over veen tzarich lomar temima veachar kach nolad bah mum kavua venifdet vehemir bah achar shennifdet. hare zo temura veenah kereva veenah nifdet ella mannichah ad shettamut. enah kereva mippene shebbaa mikkoach kedushsha dechuya veenah nifdet sheen bechoach kedushshatah litposho pidyonah:
Kol hattemurot shehayu baale mumin kevuin mittechillatan hare ellu yippadu veenan yotzin lechullin lechol davar kede sheyyihyu muttarin begizza vaavoda achar pidyonan. shehakkedushsha chala battemura al baalat mum kavua shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "o ra betov" vera haamur kan hu baal mum vechayyotze bo sheeno rauy lekarban veaf al pi chen katuv bo <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "yihye kodesh":
Ola shennitarva bizvachim vehemir beachat min hattaarovot hare ze mevi behema acheret veomer im temurat ola hi zo hare behema zo shelamim veim temurat shelamim hi zo hare behema zo ola. venimtza habbehema shehevi im hattemura keola ushelamim shennitarvu ze baze. chazar vehemir beachat mishshetehen veen yadua bee zo mehen hemir. mevi zevach acher mittoch beto. veomer al hattemura hashsheniyya. im temurat temura hi zo hare zo shehevi chullin. veim temurat ola o shelamim hi hare ze shehevi ola o shelamim. vahare ze shehevi im hattemura hashsheniyya kezevach utemura shennitarvu ze baze. uchevar bearnu din hattaarovot behilchot pesule hammukdashin:
Shelamim shennitarvu bivchor o bemaaser vehemir beechad mehen hare ze lo yikrav ella yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippade veyeachel kivchor o kemaaser kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 4: Ketzad din valdot hakkadashim. velad shelamim uvelad temurat shelamim hare ellu kishlamim vehen atzman kishlamim lechol davar. vechen velad hattoda uvelad temuratah hare ellu yikkarvu ketoda ella sheenan teunin lechem sheen meviin lechem ella im hattoda atzmah. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 12)</small> "al zevach hattoda" alav velo al veladah velo al temuratah kemo shebbearnu. bamme devarim amurim bavveladot atzman aval valde veladot enan kerevin. shemmittoch maasav nikkar shehu mashhe otan legaddel mehen adarim adarim ulefichach konsin oto velo yakrivem:
Velad hachattat yamut veen tzarich lomar velad temuratah:
Hashshochet et hachattat umatza bah ben arbaa chay hare zo neechelet kivsar hachattat. shevvalde hakkadashim bime imman hem kedoshim:

Velad temurat haasham uvelad veladah ad sof haolam yiru ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava. veim yalda zachar achar shehikriv ashamo havvalad atzmo yikkarev ola. hifrish nekeva laashamo veyalda tire hi uvenah ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyimmachru veyavi bidme shenehem ashamo. veim kevar hikriv ashamo yippelu demehen lindava:

Velad temurat haola uvelad veladah ad sof haolam hare ellu keola vehen atzman yikkarvu ola. hifrish nekeva leolato veyalda af al pi sheyyalda zachar yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyavi bedamav ola. kevar bearnu bemaase hakkarbanot shekkol makom sheanu omrin yippelu lindava hu sheyyitten hammaot bashshofarot shehayu bammikdash shebbearnu bishkalim kamma hem. uvet din makrivin beotan hammaot olot nedava veniskehem mishshel tzibbur veenan teunot semicha. aval makom shenneemar hu atzmo yikrav ola o yavi bedamav ola. hare zo teuna semicha unesacheha mishshello:

Velad hammaaser. [uvelad] temurat hammaaser. velad temurat habbechor uvalde valdotehen ad sof haolam. hare ellu lo yikkarvu ella yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyeachlu kivchor uchemaaser shennafal bahen mum. valdot temurat habbechor lechohen. valdot maaser utemurato livalav:

Velad temurat happesach kitmurat happesach. im hayta immo kereva shelamim veladah yikkarev shelamim veim haya dinah shettimmacher veyavi bedameha shelamim af veladah nimkar veyavi bedamav shelamim. hifrish nekeva lefischo veyalda. o shehifrishah meubberet. hi uveladah yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidmehen pesach. veim nishara nekeva zo ad achar happesach o sheyyalda achar happesach. tire hi uveladah ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidmehen shelamim:
Valdot hakkadashim sheyyatzu derech dofen. o sheyyaldu tumtum veanderoginus vechilayim uterefa. hare ellu yippadu veyavi bidmehen karban harauy lehavi bidme valad shel zo:
Velad baalat mum hare hu kivlad hattemima lechol davar veyikkarev karauy lo:
Kadashim shehippilu nefel o shilya yikkavru vahare hem asurim bahanaa:

Hameshanne et hakkadashim mikkedushsha likdushsha over belo taase shenneemar bivchor <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "lo yakdish ish oto" shello yaasennu ola o shelamim. vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim sheen meshannin otan mikkedushsha likdushsha echad kadshe mizbeach veechad kadshe bedek habbayit. ketzad. im hikdish levedek hahechol lo yeshanne levedek hammizbeach. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veen lokin al lav ze:

Ketzad maarimin al habbechor lehakedisho lammizbeach hekdesh acher. makdisho babbeten kodem sheyyivvaled shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "asher yevukkar laAdonai" <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "lo yakdish ish oto". mishsheyyevukkar i atta makdisho aval atta makdisho babbeten. lefichach yesh lo lomar ma shebbemeeha shel mavkeret zo im hu zachar hare zo ola. aval eno yachol lomar zivche shelamim sheeno yachol lehafekia oto mikkedushshato kede lehanot bo. veim amar im yetziat rov rosho yihye ola hare ze bechor veeno ola:

Veen maarimin al behemat hekdesh lehakedish ubbarah kedushsha acheret ella hare hu kikdushshat immo. shevvaldot hakkadashim mimmee immam hem kedoshim kemo shebbearnu. vahare kol ubbar mehen kikdushshat immo veeno yachol leshannoto babbeten kederech sheasa bivchor shehabbechor bitziato hu shemmitkaddesh. af al pi shekkol chukke hattora gezerot hem kemo shebbearnu besof meila. rauy lehitbonen bahen vechol ma sheatta yachol litten lo taam ten lo taam. hare amru chachamim harishonim shehammelech shelomo hevin rov hatteamim shel kol chukke hattora. yerae li shezze sheamar hakkatuv <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh". kainyan sheamar <small>(Vayikra 27 15)</small> "veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit kesef erkecha alav". yarda tora lesof machashevet haadam uketzat yitzro hara. shetteva shel adam note leharebot kinyano velachus al mamono veaf al pi shennadar vehikdish efshar shechazar bo venicham veyifde befachot mishshavyo amra tora im pada leatzmo yosif chomesh. vechen im hikdish behema kedushshat hagguf shemma yachzor bo vechevan sheeno yachol lifdotah yachlifenna bifchuta mimmenna. veim titten lo reshut lehachelif hara beyafe yachlif hayyafe bera veyomar tov hu. lefichach satam hakkatuv befanav shello yachlif. ukenaso im hechlif veamar vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh. vechol ellu haddevarim kede lachof et yitzro uletakken deotav. verov dine hattora enan ella etzot merachok miggedol haetza letakken haddeot uleyashsher kol hammaasim. vechen hu omer <small>(Mishlei 22 20)</small> "halo chatavti lecha shalishim bemoetzot vadaat". lehodiacha kosht imre emet lehashiv amarim emet lesholchecha:
Mishneh Torah, Tefillin, Mezuzah and the: Arba parashiyyot ellu. shehen <small>(Shemot 13 1)</small> "kaddesh li". <small>(Shemot 13 11)</small> "vehaya chi yeviacha Adonai" shebbesefer veelle shemot. u<small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema". <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa". hen shennichtavot bifne atzman umechappin otan beor venikrain tefillin umannichin otan al harosh vekoshrin otan al hayyad. vaafillu kotzo shel ot achat mearba parashiyyot ellu meakkev et kullan min hattora ad sheyyihyu nichtavot shelemot ketikkunan:

Vechen shete parashiyyot shebbammezuza shehen <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" afillu ot achat mishshete happarashiyyot im chaser kotzo meakkev min hattora ad sheyyihyu shetehen nichtavot shelemot. vechen sefer tora shechisser afillu ot achat pasul:

Asara devarim yesh battefillin kullan halacha lemoshe missinay vechullan meakkevin. lefichach im shinna beachat mehen hare hattefillin pesulot. shenayim hen bichtivatan ushemona bechippuyan ukeshirat retzuotehen. veellu hen hashshenayim shebbichtivatan. shekkotvin otan bidyo vesheyyihyu nichtavin al hakkelaf:

Ketzad maase haddeyo. mekabbetzin heashan shel shemanim o shel zefet veshel shaava vechayyotze bahen vegovlin otan bisraf hailan uvimat devash velottin oto harebe vedachin oto ad sheyyease rekikin umeyabbeshin oto umatzniin oto. uvishat ketiva shorehu beme afatzim vechayyotze bo vechotev bo. sheim timchakennu yihye nimchak. vezehu haddeyo shemmitzva min hammuvchar lichtov bo sefarim tefillin umezuzot. veim katav shelashtan beme aftza vekankantom shehu omed veeno nimchak kesheriyim:

Im ken ma miata hahalacha shenneemar lemoshe missinay sheyyihyu ketuvim bidyo. lemaet shear mine tzivonin kegon haadom vehayyarok vechayyotze bahen. sheim katav bassefarim o battefillin o bammezuzot afillu ot achat bishar mine tzivonin o bezahav hare ellu pesulin:

Shalosh orot hen. gevil ukelaf veduchesusetus. ketzad. lokchin or behema o chayya umaavirin hassear mimmennu techilla. veachar kach molchin oto bemelach. veachar kach meabbedin oto bekemach. veachar kach baaftza vechayyotze bo middevarim shemmechavvetzin et haor umechazzekin oto. veze hu hannikra gevil:

Veim lakchu haor achar sheheeviru searo vechilleku oto beavyo lishnayim kemo shehaabbedanin osin ad sheyyihyu shene orot. echad dak hu shemmimmul hassear veechad ave vehu shemmimmul habbasar veibbedu oto bemelach veachar kach bekemach veachar kach baaftza vechayyotze bo. ze hachelek shemmimmul hassear nikra duchesusetus veze shemmimmul habbasar nikra kelaf:

Halacha lemoshe missinay sheyyihyu kotvin sefer tora al haggevil vechotvin bimkom hassear. vesheyyihyu kotvin hattefillin al hakkelaf vechotvin bimkom habbasar. vesheyyihyu kotvin hammezuza al duchesusetus vechotvin bimkom hassear. vechol hakkotev al hakkelaf bimkom sear o shekkatav bigvil uveduchesusetus bimkom basar pasul:

Af al pi shekkach hi halacha lemoshe missinay im katav sefer tora al hakkelaf kasher. velo neemar gevil ella lemaet duchesusetus sheim katav alav hassefer pasul. vechen im katav et hammezuza al hakkelaf o al haggevil kasher. lo amru al duchesusetus ella lemitzva:

En kotvin sefarim tefillin umezuzot al gabbe or behema temea veof vechayya hattemeim. aval kotvin al gabbe or behema vechayya vaof tehorim vaafillu nevelot uterefot shellahen. veen kotvin al gabbe or haddag hattahor mippene hazzuhama. sheen hazzuhama poseket beibbudah:

Gevil shel sefer tora ukelaf shel tefillin o shel sefer tora tzarich leabbed otan lishman. veim ibbedan shello lishman pesulin. lefichach im ibbedan hakkuti pesulin af al pi sheamarnu lo lakkuti leabbed or ze leshem hassefer o leshem hattefillin pesulin. shehakkuti al daat atzmo hu ose lo al daat hassocher oto. lefichach kol davar shetztzarich maase lishmo im asahu hakkuti pasul. umezuza enah tzericha haavada lishmah:

Halacha lemoshe missinay sheen kotvin sefer tora velo mezuza ella besirtut. aval tefillin enan tzerichin sirtut lefi shehen mechuppin. umuttar lichtov tefillin umezuza shello min hakketav shehakkol gorsin parashiyyot ellu. aval sefer tora asur lichtov afillu ot achat shello min hakketav:

Sefer tora tefillin umezuzot shekketavan eppikoros yissarfu. ketavan kuti o yisrael mumar o moser beyad annas o eved o ishsha o katan hare ellu pesulin veyigganzu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "ukeshartam" <small>(Devarim 6 9)</small> "uchetavtam" kol shemmuzhar al hakkeshira umaamin bah hu shekkotev. nimtzeu beyad eppikoros veeno yodea mi ketavan yigganzu. nimtzeu beyad kuti kesherim. veen lokchin sefarim tefillin umezuzot min hakkutim beyoter al demehem shello leharegil otan leganvan ulegazlan:
Sefer tora tefillin umezuzot shekketavan al gabbe or behema chayya veof hattemein o al gabbe orot sheenam meubbadin o shekkatav sefer tora utefillin al or shello ibbedan lishman hare ellu pesulin:

Hakkotev sefer tora o tefillin o mezuza uvishat ketiva lo hayta lo kavvana vechatav azkara min haazkarot shebbahen shello lishman pesulin. lefichach hakkotev et hashshem afillu melech yisrael shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu. haya kotev shenayim o shelosha shemot hare ze mafsik benehem umeshiv:

Hattovel et hakkulmos lichtov et hashshem lo yatchil meot hashshem aval matchil hu meot shellefanav. shachach lichtov et hashshem kullo tole oto ben hashshittot. aval miktzat hashshem bashshitta umiktzato taluy pasul. uvishar hattevot im shachach kotev miktzat hatteva bashshitta umiktzatah lemala. bamme devarim amurim besefer tora aval bimzuza utefillin en tolin bahen afillu ot achat. ella im shachach afillu ot achat gonez ma shekkatav vechotev acheret. umuttar lichtov et hashshem al mekom haggered veal mekom hammachak bechullan:
Kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot asur lahem lahafoch hayeria al paneha ella pores aleha beged o koflah:

Sefer tora tefillin umezuza sheamar hassofer achar sheyyatzu mittachat yado lo katavti haazkarot shebbahen lishman eno neeman lefaslan aval neeman hu lehafesid kol secharo. velamma eno neeman lefaslan shemma lo nitkavven ella lehafesid al hallokeach o al ze shessecharo vedome sheeno mafsid baamira zo ella sechar haazkarot. lefichach im amar sefer tora ze o tefillin ellu orot shellahen enam meubbadot lishman mittoch shenneeman lehafesid secharo neeman lefaslan. shehare hakkol yodim sheim en haorot meubbadim lishman en sachar lo kelal:

En kotvin tefillin umezuza ella bichtav ashshurit. vehittiru bassefarim lichtov af bivani bilvad. uchevar nishka yevani min haolam venishtabbesh veavad lefichach en kotvin hayyom shelashtan ella ashshurit. vetzarich lehizzaher bichtivatan kede shello tidbak ot beot shekkol ot sheen haor makkif lah mearba ruchoteha pasul. vechol ot sheen hattinok sheeno lo chacham velo sachol yachol likrotah pasul. lefichach tzarich lehizzaher betzurat haotiyyot shello tidme hayyud levav velo vav leyud velo kaf levet velo bet lechaf velo dalet leresh velo resh ledalet vechen kol kayyotze baze ad sheyyarutz kol hakkore bahen:

Or shehaya nakuv lo yichtov al gabbe hannekev. vechol nekev shehaddeyo overet alav eno nekev umuttar lichtov alav. lefichach muttar lichtov al gabbe or haof shennitabbed. nikkav haor achar shennichtav im nikkav betoch haot kegon toch hei o toch mem vechen bishar otiyyot kasher. nikkav bayyarech shel ot ad shennifseka. im nishtayyer mimmenna melo ot ketanna kasher vehu shello tidme leot acheret. veim lo nishtayyer mimmenna melo ot ketanna pesula:

Ketzad kotvin et hattefillin shel rosh. kotvin arba parashiyyot al arba kelafin vegollin kol echad veechad levaddo umannichin otan bearba battim shehen mechubbarin beor echad. veshel yad kotvin otan haarba parashiyyot bearba dappin al kelaf echad vegollelo kemin sefer tora missofo litchillato umannicho bevayit echad:

Vetzarich lehizzaher bapparashiyyot sheim asa hassetuma petucha o happetucha setuma pesalan. usheloshet happarashiyyot harishonot kullan petuchot ufarasha acharona shehi <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" setuma:

Vetzarich lehizzaher bemale vechaser ad sheyyihyu arbatan ketuvot kemo shehen ketuvot besefer tora habbaduk. sheim katav hechaser male pasul ad sheyyimchok hayyater. veim katav hammale chaser pasul veen lo takkana. veellu hen hachaserot vehammeleot sheyyesh bearba parashiyyot ellu:

Parasha rishona <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "kaddesh li chol bechor" male. zachor male. bechozek chaser. [hotzi male. yotzim chaser vav.] yeviacha male. vehaemori chaser. vehayevusi male. laavotecha chaser vav. haavoda chaser. matztzot chaser. hashshevii male. matztzot male. seor chaser. gevulecha chaser. baavur male. leot male. ulezikkaron male. enecha male. torat male. hotziacha chaser yod. hachukka chaser. lemoadah male:

Parasha sheniyya <small>(Shemot 13 5)</small> "vehaya ki yeviacha" chaser yod. velaavotecha chaser vav. chamor chaser. bechor male. bechozek chaser. hotzianu male. vayyaharog chaser. bechor male. mibbechor chaser. vead bechor male. zoveach chaser vav. vechol bechor male. leot male. yadcha katuv beHei. uletotafot chaser vav tinyana. enecha male. bechozek chaser. hotzianu male:

Parasha shelishit <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" ayin shel shema gedola. dalet shel echad gedola. meodecha chaser. levanecha male. bevetecha belo yod sheniyya. uvekumecha male. leot male. yadecha chaser. letotafot chaser shene vavin. enecha male. mezuzot chaser vav rishona. betecha belo yod sheniyya. uvisharecha male:

Parasha reviit <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" chaser. mitzvotay beVav achat. yore male. umalkosh male. vetiroshcha chaser vav. vehishtachavitem male. yevulah male. hattova chaser. noten chaser. otam chaser. leot male. letotafot chaser vav sheniyya. enechem male. otam chaser. bevetecha belo yod sheniyya. uvekumecha male. mezuzot male. betecha belo yod sheniyya. uvisharecha male. laavotechem chaser vav:
Vetzarich lehizzaher betagin shel otiyyot vehen kemo zayinnin zekufot sheyyesh lahen tag kemo shehen ketuvin besefer tora. veellu hen haotiyyot hametuyyagot shebbearba parashiyyot ellu:

Parasha rishona yesh bah ot achat bilvad vehi mem setuma shel <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "miyyamim" aleha shalosh zayinnin. parasha sheniyya yesh lah chamesh otiyyot vechol achat mehen hei veal kol hei mechamishtan arba zayinnin. vehen hei shel <small>(Shemot 13 11)</small> "unetanah". vehe rishona vehe acharona shel <small>(Shemot 13 15)</small> "hiksha". vehe shel <small>(Shemot 13 15)</small> "vayyaharog". vehe shel <small>(Shemot 13 16)</small> "yadcha". parasha shelishit yesh bah chamesh otiyyot veellu hen kuf shel <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "uvekumecha" yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin. vekuf shel <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "ukeshartam" yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin. vetet tet fe shel <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "letotafot" al kol ot mishshelashtan arba zayinnin. parasha reviit yesh bah chamesh otiyyot. fe shel <small>(Devarim 11 14)</small> "veasafta" yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin. vetav shel veasafta yesh aleha zayin achat. vetet tet fe shel <small>(Devarim 11 18)</small> "letotafot" al kol achat mishshelashtan arba zayinnin. kol haotiyyot hametuyyagot shesh esre. veim lo asa hattagin o hosif vegara bahen lo pasal:

Hallokeach tefillin mimmi sheeno mumche tzarich levadkan. lakach mimmennu mea ketzitzot bodek mehen shalosh ketzitzot. o shetayim shel rosh veachat shel yad o shetayim shel yad veachat shel rosh. im metzaam kesherim huchzak ze haish vahare kullan kesherim veen hashshear tzarich bedika. veim lekacham tzevatim tzevatim kullan tzerichot bedika shechezkat hatztzevatim meanashim harebe lekuchim:

Hakkotev tefillin bichtav yado o shellekachan min hammumche o mishshear adam uvedakan vehecheziran leoran leolam eno tzarich levadkam paam acheret vaafillu leachar kamma shanim. kol zeman shechippuyan shalem hare hen bechezkatan. veen choshshin lahen shemma nimchaka ot mittochan o shennikkeva. hillel hazzaken haya omer ellu mishshel avi ima:

Shemone halachot yesh bemaase hattefillin kullan halacha lemoshe missinay. ulefichach kullan meakkevot veim shinna beachat mehen pasal. veellu hem. sheyyihyu merubbaot. vechen tefiratan beribbua. vaalachsonan beribbua ad sheyyihye lahen arba zaviyyot shavot. vesheyyihye baor shel rosh tzurat shin miyyamin umissemol. vesheyyichroch happarashiyyot bematlit. vesheyyichroch otan besear meal hammatlit. veachar kach machnisan bevattehen. vesheyyihyu tofrin otan begidin. vesheosin lahen maboret meor hachippuy shettikkanes bah hartzua ad shettehe overet veholechet betoch tovar shellah. vesheyyihyu hartzuot shechorot. vesheyyihye hakkesher shellahen kesher yadua ketzurat dalet:

Ketzad osim tefillin shel rosh. lokchin etz merubba arko kerachbo uchegavho. veim haya gavho yoter al rachbo o pachot mimmennu en bechach kelum. veen makpidin ella al arko sheyyehe kerachbo. vechofrin bo shelosha charitzin kede sheyyease lo arba rashim kegon ze:

velokchin or umartivin oto bemayim umesimin bo et haetz umachnisin et haor ben kol charitz vecharitz umechammeshim oto vehu ratov mikkan umikkan ad sheosin bo demut shin sheyyesh lah shelosha rashin miyyamin hammeniach tefillin udemut shin sheyyesh lah arbaa rashim missemol hammeniach:

Umannichin et haor al haetz ad sheyyivash. veachar kach choletz haor meal gabbe haimmum shel etz venimtza haor sheyyesh bo arbaa battim penuyin. umachnisin parasha bechol bayit uvayit. umachzirin miktzat haor millematta vetofrin oto mearba pinnotav. umannichin min haor shellematta makom shettikkanes bo hartzua kemo tovar vehu hannikra maboret:

Vechetzad osin tefillin shel yad. lokchin etz merubba arko kerachbo veyihye gavho keetzba o yater al ze meat o pachot meat umechappin oto beor ratov umannichin et haor al haimmum ad sheyyivash vecholetz et haor umanniach et arba happarashiyyot bimkom haetz umachazir miktzat haor millematta vetofro mearba pinnotav. umannichin min haor tovar mekom hartzuot:

Ketzad siddur happarashiyyot bitfilla shel rosh. machnis parasha acharona shehi (Devarim 11 13) "vehaya im shamoa" bevayit rishon shehu al yemin hammeniach. u (Devarim 6 4) "shema" semucha lah. (Shemot 13 11) "vehaya chi yeviacha" bevayit shelishi semucha lishma. v(Shemot 13 2) "kaddesh li" bevayit revii shehu lismol hammeniach tefillin kede sheyyehe hakkore shellefanav keneged pene hammeniach kore al hasseder hazze kegon ze: veim hechelif siddur ze pesulot:

Tefilla shel yad kotvam bearbaa dappin beor echad aroch kesefer tora al sidduran battora kegon ze

im ketavan al arba orot vehichnisan bevayit echad yatza veeno tzarich ledabbekam:
Keshehu golel happarashiyyot ben shel rosh ben shel yad golel otan missofan litchillatan ad shettimtza keshettiftach happarasha tikra kol parasha ufarasha mittechillatah ad sofah:

Ucheshemmachnisin et happarashiyyot babbattim shellahem korchin otan bematlit veal hammatlit sear veachar kach machnisin otan bevattehen. vesear ze tzarich lihyot sear behema o shel chayya tehora vaafillu minnevelot uterefot shellahen. uchevar nahagu kol haam (levarchan) [lecharchan] bisar zenav haagalim:

Keshettofrin et hattefillin en tofrin ella begidin shel behema o shel chayya tehora vaafillu minnevelot uterefot shellahen. lokchin haggidin sheyyesh baakev habbehema o hachayya tehorim vehem levanim. veim hem kashim merakkechin otan baavanim vechayyotze bahen ad sheyyeasu kefishtan vetovin otan veshozrin otan uvahen tofrin hattefillin viriot sefer tora:

Keshettofrin hattefillin tofrin otan beribbua. vahalacha rovachat sheyyihyu bechol tzad shalosh tefirot ad sheyyihyu hakkol shetem esre tefirot ben shel yad ben shel rosh. veim asa hattefirot eser o arba esre ose. vechol hattefirot yihye hachut shellahen sovev mishshete ruchot:

Vetzarich sheyyaggia hecharitz shel tefillin shel rosh ad mekom hattefer. veim haya hecharitz nikkar kede sheyyihyu arbaa rashin nirin lakkol veaf al pi sheen hecharitz maggia limkom hattefer kesherot. veim en charitz nikkar pesulot. vetzarich lehaavir betoch kol charitz vecharitz al gabbe haor chut o meshicha lehavedil ben bayit levayit. uminhag pashut lehaavir gid miggide hattefira bechol charitz vecharitz mishshelashtan:

Vechetzad osin hartzuot. lokchin retzua shel or rechava keorech hasseora. veim hayta rechava mizzo hashshiur keshera. veorech retzua shel rosh kede shettakkif et harosh veyikshor mimmenna hakkesher vetimtach shete hartzuot mikkan umikkan ad sheyyaggiu lattabbur o lemala mimmennu meat. veorech retzua shel yad kede shettakkif et hazzeroa veyikshor mimmenna hakkesher vetimmatach retzua achat al etzba emtzait veyichroch mimmenna al etzbao shalosh kerichot veyikshor. veim hayu hartzuot arukkot yater al shiurim haellu kesherot:

Umachnis retzua shel rosh battovar shellah. umakkif bemiddat rosho vekosher kesher merubba kemin dalet. vekesher ze tzarich kol talmid chacham lelamdo vei efshar lehodia tzurato bichtav ella biriyyat haayin. vechen beshel yad kosher kesher kemin yod. vetihye hartzua shel yad ola veyoredet betoch hakkesher kede sheyyarchiv vikatztzer beet sheyyirtze likshor al yado:

Hartzuot shel tefillin ben shel rosh ben shel yad penehem hachitzonim shechorim vezo halacha lemoshe missinay. aval achore hartzuot hoil umibbifnim hen im hayu yerukkot o levanot kesherot. adummot lo yaase shemma tehafech hartzua ugenay hu lo. velo yihye achore hartzua leolam ella keen hakketzitza im yerukka yerukkin veim levana levanim. venoy hu lattefillin sheyyihyu kullan shechorot hakketzitza vehartzua kullah:

Haor shemmechappin bo hattefillin vesheosin mimmennu hartzuot hu or shel behema o chayya o of hattehorim vaafillu nevelot uterefot shellahen. veim asa meor temeim o shechippa tefillin bezahav pesulot. veor hartzua tzarich ibbud lishmah. aval beor shemmechappin bo eno tzarich ibbud kelal afillu asahu matztza kasher. umekomot harebe nahagu laasot otan beor matztza:

En osin hattefillin ella yisrael sheasiyyatan kichtivatan mippene hashshin sheosin baor kemo sheamarnu. lefichach im chippan hakkuti o tefaran pesulot vehu haddin lechol happasul lechatvan shello yaase otan:

Tefilla shel rosh en osin otah shel yad veshel yad osin otah shel rosh lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla. vechen retzua shel tefilla shel rosh en osin otah litfilla shel yad. bamme devarim amurim keshellevashan. aval tefillin shel rosh shello levashan adam meolam im ratza lehachaziran leyad muttar. vechetzad osin. tole aleha or ad shettease achat vekoshrah al yado:

Tefillin shennifseku hattefirot shellahen im hayu shete hattefirot zo betzad zo o shennifseku shalosh tefirot afillu zo shello keneged zo hare ellu pesulot. bamme devarim amurim bishanot aval bachadashot kol zeman sheppene tavlan kayyamot kesherot. veellu hen hachadashot kol sheochazin miktzat haor shennikra tifro vetolin bo hattefillin vehu chazak veeno nichrat hare ellu chadashot. veim en rauy litlot bo ella hu nifsak hare ellu yeshanot:

Retzua shennifseka en koshrin otah veen tofrin otah ella motziah vegonzah veosin acheret. veshiyyure hartzua pesulin ad sheyyehe arkah verachbah kashshiur o yater alav. uleolam yizzaher lihyot pene hartzua lemala beet shekkosher otan al yado veal rosho:

Hechan menichin tefillin shel rosh. menichin otan al hakkadkod shehu sof hassear shekkeneged happanim vehu hammakom shemmocho shel tinok rofes bo. vetzarich lechavven otam baemtza kede sheyyihyu ben haenayim. veyihye hakkesher begova haoref shehu sof haggulgolet:

Veshel yad kosher otah al semolo al hakkibboret vehu habbasar hattofeach shebbammarpek shebben perek hakkatef uven perek hazzeroa shennimtza keshehu medabbek marpeko litzlaav tihye tefilla keneged libbo venimtza mekayyem <small>(Devarim 6 6)</small> "vehayu haddevarim haelle" <small>(Devarim 6 6)</small> "al levavecha":

Hammeniach tefilla shel yad al pas yado o shel rosh al mitzcho hare ze derech tzedokim. haose tefillato agulla keegoz en bah mitzva kelal. itter meniach tefillin bimino shehu semol shello. veim haya sholet bishte yadav meniach otah bismolo shehu semol kol adam. umekom keshirat hattefillin umekom hanachatan mippi hashshemua lemadum:

Tefilla shel rosh enah meakkevet shel yad veshel yad enah meakkevet shel rosh mippene shehen shete mitzvot zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah. vechetzad mevarchin. al shel rosh mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat tefillin. veal shel yad mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehanniach tefillin:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheheniach achat mehen aval im heniach shetehen mevarech beracha achat vehi lehanniach tefillin. vekosher shel yad veachar kach meniach shel rosh. ucheshehu choletz choletz shel rosh veachar kach choletz shel yad:

Mi shebberech lehanniach tefillin vekashar tefillin shel yad asur lo lesapper vaafillu lehashiv shalom lerabbo ad sheyyaniach shel rosh. veim sach hare zo avera vetzarich levarech beracha sheniyya al mitzvat tefillin veachar kach meniach shel rosh:

Tefillin kol zeman shemmenichan mevarech alehen vaafillu choletz velovesh kamma peamim beyom. vechol hammitzvot kullan mevarech alehem kodem laasiyyatan. lefichach tzarich levarech al hattefilla shel yad achar hanacha al hakkibboret kodem keshiratan. shekkeshiratan zo hi asiyyatan:

Keshecholetz adam tefillav lehatzenian bichli lo yanniach shel yad millematta veshel rosh millemala mippene shebbeshaa shehu rotze lelavshan yifga beshel rosh techilla venimtza shemmannichah umotzi shel yad lefi sheen lovshin shel rosh kodem shel yad. veasur laadam lehanniach mitzva velaavor mimmenna lemitzva acheret ella mitzva shettavo leyado shel adam battechilla bah hu mitassek. lefichach tzarich lehanniach shel yad lemala kede sheyyifga bah techilla veyilbash al hasseder:

Keli shehechino lehanniach bo tefillin vehinnicham bo nitkaddesh veasur lehishtammesh bo bedivre chol. hechino velo hinniach bo o shehinniach bo aray velo hechino lo nitkaddesh vahare hu chol kemo shehaya. veasur litlot et hattefillin ben bartzua ben battefilla atzmah aval tole hu et hakkis shehattefillin munnachin bo:

Zeman hanachat hattefillin bayyom velo ballayla shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "miyyamim yamima". <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "chukka" zo hi mitzvat tefillin. vechen shabbatot veyamim tovim enan zeman tefillin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 16)</small> "vehaya leot" veshabbatot veyamim tovim hen atzman ot. umeematay zeman hanachatan mishsheyyire et chavero berichuk arba ammot veyakkirehu, ad shettishka hachamma:

Mi sheheniach tefillin kodem shettishka hachamma vechashcha alav afillu hen alav kol hallayla muttar. veen morin davar ze larabbim ella melammedin et hakkol shello yanichu tefillin alehen ballayla ella yachletzu otan mishshettishka hachamma. vechol hammeniach tefillin lechattechilla achar shettishka hachamma over belav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "veshamarta et hachukka hazzot" vegomer <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "miyyamim yamima":

Haya ba badderech utefillin berosho veshaka alav hachamma vekadash hayyom manniach yado alehen ad shehu maggia leveto vecholetz. haya yoshev bevet hammidrash utefillin berosho vekadash alav hayyom manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia leveto vecholetz. veim yesh bayit samuch lachoma shemmishtammerin bo mannichan sham. veim lo chalatz tefillav mishsheshshaka hachamma mippene shello haya lo makom leshamran venimtzau alav kede leshamran muttar:

Kol happatur mikkeriat shema patur mittefillin. katan sheyyodea lishmor tefillav aviv lokeach lo tefillin kede lechannecho bemitzvot. chole meayim vechol mi shello yachol lishmor et nekavav ella betzaar patur min hattefillin. vechol hattemeim kullan chayyavin bitfillin kithorim. mitztaer umi sheen dato meyushshevet unechona alav patur min hattefillin shehammeniach tefillin asur lo lehassiach dato mehen. kohanim bishat haavoda vehaleviyyim beshaa sheomrim hashshir al hadduchan veyisrael beshaa sheomdim bammikdash peturin min hattefilla umin hattefillin:

Chayyav adam lemashmesh bitfillav kol zeman shehem alav shello yassiach dato mehem afillu rega echad. shekkedushshatan gedola mikkedushshat hatztzitz. shehatztzitz en bo ella shem echad veellu yesh bahem echad veesrim shem shel yod hei beshel rosh uchemotan beshel yad:

Tefillin tzerichin guf naki sheyyizzaher shello tetze mimmennu ruach millematta kol zeman shehem alav. lefichach asur lishan bahem lo shenat keva velo shenat aray ella im hinniach alehen sudar velo hayta immo ishsha yashen bahem shenat aray. vketzad hu ose. manniach rosho ben birkav vehu yoshev veyashen:

Hayu tefillav keruchin beyado muttar lishon bahem afillu shenat keva. veeno ochel bahem ella achilat aray. aval im nichnas lisuddat keva choltzan umannichan al shulchano ad sheyyittol yadav veachar kach yenichem vivarech al mezono vehu lavush bahen:

Haya lavush tefillin vehutzrach levet hakkisse lo yanniach hattefillin bachorin hassemuchin lirshut harabbim veyikkanes shemma yittelum ovre derachim. ketzad yaase. afillu hutzrach lehashetin mayim choletz tefillav berichuk arba ammot vegollan bevigdo kemin sefer tora veochazan bimino keneged libbo. veyizzaher kede shello tehe retzua yotzet mittachat yado tefach. venichnas veose tzerachav. uchesheyyetze marchik arba ammot mibbet hakkisse velovshan:

Bamme devarim amurim bevet hakkisse hakkavua sheen nitzotzot nittazot alav. aval bet hakkisse aray lo yikkanes bahen keshehem gelulim ella choletz otan venotnan lachavero leshamran. veen me raglayim kalin afillu bevet hakkisse kavua ella bishiva. veim haya afar tachuach afillu baamida. haya bemakom kashe yaamod bimkom midron kede shello yinnatzu nitzotzot alav:

Haya lavush bitfillin vehutzrach levet hakkisse leet erev velo nishar min hayyom kede lelavshan achar sheyyetze lo yikkanes bahem gelulim bevigdo vaafillu lehashetin mayim bevet hakkisse kavua. ella ketzad yaase. choltzan umannichan bechelyan im haya bo tefach o bichli sheeno kelyan af al pi sheen bo tefach veochez hakkeli beyado venichnas. vechen im hutzrach ballayla mannichan bichli veochez hakkeli beyado venichnas:

Shachach venichnas levet hakkisse vehu lavush tefillin meniach yado alehen ad sheyyigmor ammud rishon veyotze vecholetz. achar kach nichnas veose tzerachav. sheim yafsik beammud rishon ben bigdolim ben biktannim yavo lide cholaim sheyyesh bahen sakkana gedola:
Shachach veshimmesh mittato bitfillin hare ze lo yochaz lo bartzua velo bakketzitza ad sheyyittol yadav veyittelem mippene shehayyadayim askaniyyot:

Hannichnas levet hammerchatz makom shebbene adam omdin levushin muttar lehanniach tefillin. umakom shebbene adam omdin sham miktzatan arumim umiktzatan levushin eno choletz tefillav veeno meniach sham tefillin lechattechilla. umakom shebbene adam omdim arumim choletz tefillav veen tzarich lomar sheeno meniach:

Lo yehallech adam bevet hakkevarot utefillin berosho. vaafillu betoch arba ammot shel met o betoch arba ammot shel kever tzarich lachalotz tefillav ad sheyyarchik arba ammot. velo yilbash adam tefillin ad sheyyechasse ervato veyilbash begadav. hannose massooy al rosho choletz tefillav shel rosh ad sheyyasir hammassooy mealav vaafillu mitpachat asur lehanniach al harosh sheyyesh bo tefillin. aval tzonef hu mitznafto al tefillav:

Bayit sheyyesh bo tefillin o sefer tora asur leshammesh bo mittato ad sheyyotziem o yannichem bichli veyanniach hakkeli bichli acher sheeno kelyan. aval im haya hakkeli hashsheni mezumman lahem afillu asara kelim kichli echad hen chashuvin. veim hinnichan keli betoch keli muttar lehannichan tachat meraashotav ben kar lecheset shello keneged rosho kede leshamran vaafillu ishto immo bammitta:

Kedushshat tefillin kedushshatan gedola hi. shekkol zeman shehattefillin berosho shel adam veal zeroo hu anav vire shamayim veeno nimshach bischok uvesicha betela veeno mehareher machashavot raot ella mefanne libbo bedivre haemet vehatztzedek. lefichach tzarich adam lehishtaddel lihyotan alav kol hayyom shemmitzvatan kach hi. amru alav al rav talmido shel rabbenu hakkadosh shekkol yamav lo rauhu shehalach arba ammot belo tora o belo tzitzit o belo tefillin:

Af al pi shemmitzvatan lelavshan kol hayyom, bishat tefilla yoter min hakkol. amru chachamim kol hakkore keriat shema belo tefillin keillu meid edut sheker beatzmo. vechol sheeno meniach tefillin over bishmona ase shehare bearba parashiyyot tzivva al tefillin shel rosh veal tefillin shel yad. vechol haragil bitfillin maarich yamim shenneemar <small>(Yeshayahu 38 16)</small> "Adonai alehem yichyu":

Ketzad kotvin et hammezuza. kotvin shete parashiyyot <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" al daf echad biria achat veose lah revach millematta verevach millemala kemo chatzi tzipporen. veim ketavah bishnayim o bishlosha dappin keshera. uvilvad shello yaasenna kezanav o kemo iggul o kekubba veim asa keachat meelle pesula. ketavah shello al hasseder kegon shehikdim parasha lefarasha pesula. ketavah bishne orot af al pi shettefaran pesula. sefer tora shebbala utefillin shebbalu en osin mehen mezuza. velo min haggilyonim shel sefer tora en kotvin alav mezuza lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla:

Umitzva laasot revach shebben parashat <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" li <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" parasha setuma. veim asa otah petucha keshera lefi sheenah semucha lah min hattora. vetzarich lehizzaher betagin shebbah. veellu hen hattagin sheosin bammezuza:

Parasha rishona yesh bah sheva otiyyot al kol ot mehen shelosha zayinnin. veellu hen. shin ayin shel <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" venun d<small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "nafshecha" utere zayinnin shel mezuzot utere tetin shel <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "totafot". ufarasha sheniyya yesh bah shesh otiyyot al kol ot mehen shelosha zayinnin. veellu hen. gimel shel <small>(Devarim 11 14)</small> "deganecha" utere zayinnin shel <small>(Devarim 6 9)</small> "mezuzot" utere tetin shel totafot vetzaddik shel <small>(Devarim 11 21)</small> "haaretz". veim lo asa tagin o shehosif bahen o gara mehen lo pasal. veim ketavah shello besirtut o shello dikdek bemale vechaser o shehosif mibbifnim afillu ot achat hare zo pesula:

Minhag pashut shekkotvim al hammezuza mibbachutz keneged harevach shebben parasha lefarasha shadday veen baze hefsed lefi shehu mibbachutz. aval ellu shekkotvin mibbifnim shemot hammalachim o shemot kedoshim o pasuk o chotamot hare hen bichlal mi sheen lahem chelek laolam habba. sheellu hattippeshim lo day lahem shebbittelu hammitzva ella sheasu mitzva gedola shehi yichud hashshem shel hakkadosh baruch hu veahavato vaavodato keillu hu kamea shel hanayat atzman kemo sheala al libbam hassachol shezzehu davar hamehanne behavele haolam:

Umitzva lichtov <small>(Devarim 11 21)</small> "al haaretz" beshita acharona ben berosh ben (beemtza) hashshita. venahagu kol hassofrim lichtov otah bishtayim veesrim shitot veal haaretz berosh shita acharona. veellu hen haotiyyot shebberosh kol shita veshita al hasseder. shema. Adonai. haddevarim. levanecha. uveshachbecha. ben. vehaya. metzavve. bechol. yore. esev. pen. vehishtachavitem. hashshamayim. vaavadtem. vesamtem. otam. otam. badderech. uvisharecha. asher. al haaretz:

Keshekkoflin otah gollin otah missof hashshita litchillatah ad shettimtza kesheyyiftach hakkore likrot yikra merosh hashshita lesofah. veachar sheggollah mannichah bishfoferet shel kane o shel etz o shel kol davar umechabber otah el mezuzat happetach bemasmer o chofer bimzuzat happetach umachnis bah hammezuza:

Vekodem sheyyikbaenna bimzuzat happetach mevarech techilla. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu likboa mezuza. veeno mevarech bishat ketivatah shekkeviatah zo hi hammitzva:

Telaah bemakkel pesula sheen zo kevua. hinnichah achare haddelet lo asa kelum. chafar bimzuzat happetach vehichnis hammezuza kemo neger vehi kivriach hakkerashim battabbaot pesula. heemik lah tefach pesula. chatach kane vehichnis bo mezuza veachar kach chibber hakkane el kanim acherim veheemid min hakkol mezuzat happetach pesula mippene shekkadma keviat hammezuza laasiyyat mezuzat happetach:
Mezuzat hayyachid nivdeket paamayim beshavua. umezuzat rabbim paamayim beyovel. shemma nikrea mimmenna ot achat o nimchaka mippene shehi kevua bakketalim markevet:

Hakkol chayyavin bimzuza afillu nashim vaavadim. umechannechim et hakketannim laasot mezuza levattehem. hassocher bayit bechutza laaretz vehaddar befundak beeretz yisrael patur min hammezuza sheloshim yom. aval hassocher bayit beeretz yisrael chayyav bimzuza miyyad:

Hammaskir bayit lachavero al hassocher lehavi mezuza velikboa otah afillu haya noten sachar al keviatah. mippene shehammezuza chovat haddar hi veenah chovat habbayit. ucheshehu yotze lo yittelenna beyado veyetze. veim haya habbayit shel kuti hare ze notlah kesheyyetze:

Asara tenain yesh babbayit veachar kach yitchayyev haddar bo laasot lo mezuza. veim chaser tenay echad mehen patur min hammezuza. veellu hen. sheyyihye bo arba ammot al arba ammot o yater. veshettihyena lo shete mezuzot. veyihye lo mashkof. vetihye lo tikra. veyihyu lo delatot. veyihye hashshaar gavoah asara tefachim o yoter. veyihye habbayit chol. veyihye asuy ledirat adam. veasuy ledirat kavod. veasuy ledirat keva:

Bayit sheen lo arba ammot al arba ammot patur min hammezuza. veim yesh bo kede lerabbea arba ammot al arba ammot beshave af al pi shehu agol o baal chamesh zaviyyot veen tzarich lomar sheim haya arko yater al rachbo hoil veyesh bo lerabbea arba ammot al arba ammot chayyav bimzuza:

Achsadra vehu hammakom sheyyesh lo shelosha ketalim vetikra af al pi sheyyesh lah shene patztzimin beruach reviit petura min hammezuza. mippene shehappatztzimin lehaamid hattikra hem asuyim velo mishshum mezuzot naasu. vechen hattikra sheen lah ketalim ella omedet al ammudim mikkan umikkan af al pi shehi ketavnit bayit petura lefi sheen lah mezuzot. sheellu haammudim lehaamid hattikra hen asuyin:

Bayit sheyyesh lo mezuza mikkan umikkan vechippa kemin keshet al shete hammezuzot bimkom hammashkof. im yesh begova hammezuzot asara tefachim o yater chayyav bimzuza. veim en bahen asara tefachim peturin mippene sheen lo mashkof:

Bayit sheen lo tikra patur min hammezuza. haya miktzato mekore umiktzato eno mekore yerae li sheim haya hakkeruy keneged happetach shehu chayyav bimzuza umaamidin haddelatot veachar kach kovin et hammezuza:

Har habbayit halleshachot vehaazarot uvatte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot sheen bahen bet dira peturin lefi shehen kodesh. bet hakkeneset shel kefarim shehaorchin darin bo chayyav bimzuza. vechen bet hakkeneset shel kerakkin im haya bo bet dira chayyav. kol hashshearim shehayu bammikdash lo haya lahem mezuzot chutz mishshaar nikkanor veshellefanim mimmennu. veshel lishkat parhedrin mippene shehallishka hazzot hayta bet dira lechohen gadol beshivat yeme hahafrasha:

Bet hatteven bet habbakar bet haetzim bet otzarot peturin min hammezuza, shenneemar betecha, betcha hameyuchad lecha, perat leellu vechayyotze bahen. lefichach refet habbakar shehannashim yoshvot bah umitikashshitot bah chayyavot bimizuza shehare yesh bah yichud ledirat adam. bet shaar achsadra umirpeset vehagginna vehaddir peturin min hammezuza mippene sheenam asuyin ledira. im hayu battim hachayyavin bimzuza petuchin limkomot ellu chayyavin bimzuza:

Lefichach echad shaare chatzerot veechad shaare mevoot veechad shaare medinot vaayarot hakkol chayyavim bimzuza shehare habbattim hachayyavin bimzuza petuchin letochan. afillu asara battim ze patuach leze veze patuach leze hoil vehappenimi chayyav bimzuza kullan chayyavin. umippene ze amru shaar happatuach min hagginna lechatzer chayyav bimzuza:

Bet hakkisse uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila uvet habburseki vechayyotze bahem peturin min hammezuza lefi sheenan asuyin ledirat kavod. sukkat chag bechag uvayit shebbassefina peturin min hammezuza lefi sheenan asuyin ledirat keva. shete sukkot shel yotzrim zo lefanim mizzo hachitzona petura min hammezuza lefi sheenah kevua. hachanuyyot shebbashshevakim peturin mippene sheenan kevuim ledira:

Bayit sheyyesh lo petachim harebe af al pi sheeno ragil latzet velavo ella beachat mehen chayyav laasot mezuza bechol petach ufetach. petach katan shebben bayit laaliyya chayyav bimzuza. cheder shebbabbayit afillu cheder becheder chayyav laasot mezuza al shaar hacheder happenimi veal shaar hacheder hachitzon veal shaar habbayit shekkullan asuyin ledira ukevuin:

Petach shebben bet hammidrash o ben bet hakkeneset uveto im ragil latzet velavo beoto happetach chayyav bimzuza. petach shebben shene battim holchin achar hatztzir shel delet, makom shehatztzir nire immo sham kovim et hammezuza:

Vehechan kovim et hammezuza. betoch chalal shel patach battefach hassamuch lachutz bitchillat shelish haelyon shel gova hashshaar. veim kevaah lemala mizze keshera. vehu sheyyarchikenna min hammashkof tefach. vetzarich lekavah al yemin hannichnas labbayit veim kevaah missemol pesula. uvayit shel shuttafin chayyav bimzuza:

Chayyav adam lehizzaher bimzuza mippene shehi chovat hakkol tamid. vechol zeman sheyyikkanes veyetze yifga beyichud hashshem shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu veyizkor ahavato veyeor mishshenato veshigyotav behavele hazzeman. veyeda sheen davar haomed leolam uleolme olamim ella yediat tzur haolam. umiyyad hu chozer ledato veholech bedarche mesharim. amru chachamim harishonim kol mi sheyyesh lo tefillin berosho uvizroo vetzitzit bevigdo umezuza befitcho muchzak hu shello yecheta shehare yesh lo mazkirin rabbim vehen hem hammalachim shemmatztzilin oto millachato shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 34 8)</small> "chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem":

Mitzvat ase al kol ish veish miyyisrael lichtov sefer tora leatzmo shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 19)</small> "veatta kitvu lachem et hashshira". kelomar kitvu lachem tora sheyyesh bah shira zo, lefi sheen kotvin et hattora parashiyyot parashiyyot. veaf al pi shehinnichu lo avotav sefer tora mitzva lichtov mishshello. vim ketavo beyado hare hu keillu kibbelah mehar sinay. veim eno yodea lichtov acherim kotvin lo. vechol hammaggiah sefer tora vaafillu ot achat hare hu keillu ketavo kullo:

Vehammelech mitzva alav lichtov sefer tora echad leatzmo leshem hammelech yater al sefer sheyyihye lo keshehu hedyot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 18)</small> "vehaya cheshivto al kisse mamlachto vechatav lo" vegomer. umaggihin oto missefer haazara al pi bet din haggadol. ze shehaya lo keshehu hedyot mannicho bevet genazav. veze shekkatav o shennichtav lo achar shemmalach yihye immo tamid. veim yatza lammilchama sefer tora immo. nichnas vehu immo. yoshev baddin vehu immo. mesev vehu kenegdo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav":

Lo haya lo sefer tora kodem sheyyimloch tzarich lichtov lo achar shemmalach shene sifre tora. echad mannicho bevet genazav. vehashsheni yihye immo tamid lo yasur meimmo ella ballayla bilvad uchesheyyikkanes levet hammerchatz o levet hakkisse o lishon al mittato:

Sefer tora shekketavo belo sirtut o shekketavo miktzato al haggevil umiktzato al hakkelaf pasul ella o kullo al haggevil o kullo al hakkelaf. vechetzad kotvin sefer tora. kotev ketiva metukkenet naa beyoter. yanniach ben kol teva veteva kimlo ot ketanna uven ot leot kimlo chut hassaara uven kol shita veshita kimlo shita. veorech kol shita veshita sheloshim otiyyot kede lichtov lemishpechotechem lemishpechotechem lemishpechotechem telata zimne. veze hu rochav kol daf vedaf. velo tehe shita ketzara mizze kede shello yehe haddaf keiggeret. velo arkah yoter al ze kede shello yehu enav meshottot bakketav:

Lo yemaet hakketav mippene harevach shebben parasha lefarasha. nizdammena lo teva bat chamesh otiyyot lo yichtov shetayim betoch haddaf veshalosh chutz laddaf ella kotev shalosh betoch haddaf ushetayim chutz laddaf. lo nishar min hashshita kede lichtov shalosh otiyyot meniach hammakom panuy umatchil mittechillat hashshita:

Nizdammena lo teva bat shete otiyyot lo yizrekenna ben haddappin ella yachazir litchillat hashshita. nizdammena lo betoch hashshita teva bat eser otiyyot o pachot o yater velo nishar min hashshita kede lichtov et kullah betoch haddaf im yachol lichtov chetzyah betoch haddaf vechetzyah chutz laddaf kotev veim lav meniach hammakom panuy umatchil mittechillat hashshita:

Umeniach ben kol chummash vechummash arba shitin penuyot belo ketiva lo pachot velo yater. veyatchil hachummash mittechillat shita chamishit. uchesheyyigmor et hattora tzarich sheyyigmor beemtza shita shebbesof haddaf. veim nishar min haddaf shitin harebe mekatztzer veole umatchil mittechillat hashshita shebbesof haddaf velo yigmor et hashshita. umitkavven ad sheyyihye <small>(Devarim 34 12)</small> "leene kol yisrael" beemtza shita shebbesof haddaf:

Veyizzaher baotiyyot haggedolot uvaotiyyot hakketannot uvaotiyyot hannekuddot veotiyyot hameshunnot kegon happein hallefufot vehaotiyyot haakummot kemo shehetiku hassofrim ish mippi ish. veyizzaher battagin uveminyanan. yesh ot sheyyesh aleha tag echad veyesh ot sheyyesh aleha shiva. vechol hattagin ketzurat zayinnin hen dakkin kechut hassaara:

Kol haddevarim haellu lo neemru ella lemitzva min hammuvchar. veim shinna betikkun ze o shello dikdek battagin vechatav kol haotiyyot ketikkunan o shekkerev et hashshitin o hirchikan o heerichan o kitztzeran hoil velo hidbikan ot beot velo chisser velo hotir velo hifsid tzurat ot achat velo shinna biftuchot usetumot hare ze sefer kasher:

Yesh devarim acherim shello neemru baggemara venahagu bahem hassofrim vekabbala hu beyadam ish mippi ish. vehen sheyyihyu minyan hashshitin shebbechol daf vedaf lo pachot mishshemona vearbaim velo yater al shishshim. vesheyyihye harevach shebben parasha lefarasha kemo tesha otiyyot asher asher asher. vesheyyihye berosh hashshitin lemala mishshirat hayyam <small>(Shemot 14 28 lo)</small> "habbaim. vayyabbasha. hashshem. met. bemitzrayim". chamesh shitin. ulematta min hashshira chamesh shitin techillat kol shita mehen kach. <small>(Shemot 15 20 23)</small> "vattikkach. achareha. sus. vayyetzu. vayyavou". veyihye berashe hashshitin lemala mishshirat haazinu. <small>(Devarim lo 29 30)</small> "veaida. achare. hadderech. beacharit. lehacheiso. kehal". shesh shitin. ulematta mimmenna chamesh shitin <small>(Devarim 32 44 47)</small> "vayyavo. ledabber. asher. hazzot. asher":

Sefer tora sheeno muggah asur lishhoto yoter al sheloshim yom ella yetakken o yigganez. sefer tora sheyyesh bo shalosh taeyyot bechol daf vedaf yetakken veim hayu arba yigganez. veim haya rov hassefer muggah vehashshear yesh bo arba tauyyot bechol daf venishar afillu daf echad meoto hashshear hameshubbash belo arba taeyyot hare ze yetakken:

Bamme devarim amurim shekkatav hammale chaser shennimtza tole haotiyyot sheshshachach bene hashshitot. aval im katav hechaser male afillu yesh bechol daf vedaf kamma taeyyot hare ze metakken mippene shehu gored veeno tole:

Muttar lichtov hattora kol chummash vechummash bifne atzmo veen bahen kedushshat sefer tora. aval lo yichtov megilla bifne atzmah sheyyihye bah parashiyyot. veen kotvin megilla letinok lehitlammed bah. veim dato lehashelim aleha chummash muttar. katav megilla shalosh shalosh tevot beshita achat muttar:
